title: The Pandora Campaign
description: The starting campaign for new Pandora MMO groups.

crossroads_tavern.name: The Crossroads Tavern
crossroads_tavern.description: A weathered inn where every road out of town seems to meet. The fire never quite warms the back corner.

sensory_connections.whispering_wood: A rutted dirt road runs west out of the yard, straight for a stretch before curving out of sight toward a dark, unbroken tree line — the Whispering Wood, farther off than it looks from the tavern steps.
sensory_connections.stonearch_bridge: East, past the last few rooftops, the road narrows and climbs toward a low stone rise — Stonearch Bridge is up and over that rise, out of sight until you're most of the way there.

hearth_mantle.name: the hearth mantle
hearth_mantle.description: Carved dates and initials from a hundred travelers crowd the old wood, half worn smooth by hands running over them for luck.

regulars_board.name: the corkboard by the door
regulars_board.description: Taped-up notices, faded flyers, a couple of crude wanted posters. One scrap of paper has no name and no signature, just three words in shaky charcoal: IT COUNTS DOORS.

grimsbys_ledger.name: the heavy ledger behind the bar
grimsbys_ledger.description: Grimsby keeps it within arm's reach at all times and has never once let anyone else turn a page.

market_row.name: Market Row
market_row.description: A crooked street of stalls and shopfronts. A locksmith here has stopped taking new keys to cut.

marens_scale.name: Old Maren's brass scale
marens_scale.description: An ornate weighing scale on the counter. Maren swears by its accuracy, but it never quite balances evenly, even with identical weights on both sides.

shuttered_stall.name: a boarded-up stall
shuttered_stall.description: Nailed shut from the outside, which is the strange part — nobody in Market Row admits to knowing who used to run it.

locksmiths_keys.name: rows of hanging keys in the locksmith's window
locksmiths_keys.description: Dozens of unlabeled keys, none cut to any lock still in use in town, as far as anyone will say. Someone still dusts them.

marens_strongbox.name: Old Maren's locked strongbox
marens_strongbox.description: An old strongbox Maren's lost the combination to. A riddle is carved into its lid, worn but still legible: "I have cities, but no houses; forests, but no trees; rivers, but no water. What am I?"

the_colosseum.name: The Colosseum
the_colosseum.description: A weathered ring of stone stands apart from the market's noise, its sand still dark in patches from bouts nobody talks about after. A challenger's bell hangs by the gate, worn smooth from use.

combat_environment.name: the arena's dark-stained sand
combat_environment.description: Ground in over years of bouts nobody talks about after -- kicked up hard enough, it blinds and cuts.

whispering_wood.name: The Whispering Wood
whispering_wood.description: An old forest where the leaves move without wind. Locals say the trees remember things.

resource_nodes.name: a patch of Silverleaf Herbs
a stand of old, sturdy timber
a rotted log slumped under the low bushes

listening_tree.name: an ancient, wide-boled tree
listening_tree.description: Its bark seems to almost resolve into faces at the edge of your vision — never quite there when you look straight at it.

carved_waystone.name: a weathered waystone
carved_waystone.description: A trailside marker carved with a script no one in the Crossroads can read, in strokes too regular to be natural weathering.

whispering_wood_deep_glade.name: The Deep Glade
whispering_wood_deep_glade.description: The canopy closes overhead here, thick enough that even the leaves' restless movement comes through muffled, like something heard through a wall.

resource_nodes.name: a stand of deadfall timber, dry and untouched

glade_hollow_ring.name: a perfect ring of mushrooms
glade_hollow_ring.description: Too even to be natural, too old to be anyone's doing. Nothing else grows inside it.

whispering_wood_mossy_creek.name: The Mossy Creek
whispering_wood_mossy_creek.description: A slow, quiet creek threading between the roots. The water runs clear enough to see the bottom, and still no one fishes it after dark.

resource_nodes.name: the creek's slow-moving shallows
a soft mudbank along the creek's edge

creek_stones.name: a line of flat stepping stones
creek_stones.description: Worn smooth and evenly spaced, as if placed rather than found — though no one living remembers placing them.

whispering_wood_bramble_thicket.name: The Bramble Thicket
whispering_wood_bramble_thicket.description: Brambles grown into a wall taller than a person, with exactly one gap wide enough to push through. Something kept it that way.

thicket_gap.name: the single gap through the brambles
thicket_gap.description: Just wide enough for one person at a time, thorns pulled back and tied off with old, sun-bleached cord.

whispering_wood_elder_glen.name: The Elder Glen
whispering_wood_elder_glen.description: The oldest trees in the Wood stand here in a loose, deliberate circle, bark carved smooth by centuries of wind. Locals say the trees remember things — here, it feels like they're the ones doing the watching.

resource_nodes.name: a rare, pale patch of Silverleaf Herbs

the_watching_circle.name: the ring of ancient, wind-smoothed trees
the_watching_circle.description: Stand in the center and the leaves go still, all at once, all around you — the only place in the whole Wood where they ever stop moving.

elder_carved_riddle.name: words worn into the widest tree's bark
elder_carved_riddle.description: Carved so long ago the bark's grown almost smooth over it, but still legible: "I have many rings but no fingers, many arms but no hands, and I tell your age without ever asking. What am I?"

hollow_stump_shrine.name: The Hollow Stump Shrine
hollow_stump_shrine.description: A shrine built into the base of a tree wider than a house, long since dead. Offerings left here are never touched by animals.

resource_nodes.name: Moonpetal flowers growing at the shrine's base

offering_line.name: a row of small offerings
offering_line.description: Trinkets, coins, and dried flowers laid out at the shrine's base with an unnerving, exact symmetry no one seems to have arranged on purpose.

stumps_rings.name: the stump's growth rings
stumps_rings.description: Visible where the outer bark has fallen away. One ring, deep in, is far darker than all the others — as if that entire year burned instead of grew.

greymoor_downs.name: The Greymoor Downs
greymoor_downs.description: Rolling grey hills under a sky that seems one shade too dim, even at noon.

resource_nodes.name: a scatter of loose stones at the base of the standing stones

standing_stones.name: a loose ring of standing stones
standing_stones.description: Weathered megaliths, all leaning in the same direction, like something long ago pushed the whole hill sideways at once.

old_bandit_camp.name: a cold, abandoned campsite
old_bandit_camp.description: Ash gone stiff and grey, and a boot print frozen in old mud, pointed toward the road rather than away from it.

greymoor_downs_windswept_ridge.name: The Windswept Ridge
greymoor_downs_windswept_ridge.description: A high spine of rock along the Downs, wind loud enough here to cover most other sound. Good for seeing a long way. Good for not being heard, too.

ridge_cairn_markers.name: a line of small stacked-stone markers
ridge_cairn_markers.description: Spaced too evenly to be idle piling, all pointing the same direction along the ridge — toward the cairn further north.

greymoor_downs_lonely_cairn.name: The Lonely Cairn
greymoor_downs_lonely_cairn.description: A single burial cairn, well kept for something no one admits to visiting. Whoever tends it doesn't want to be found doing it.

the_cairn_itself.name: the cairn's carefully fitted stones
the_cairn_itself.description: No name carved anywhere on it, but the topmost stone is always clean — swept clear, again and again, of whatever the wind piles onto it.

greymoor_downs_broken_watchtower.name: The Broken Watchtower
greymoor_downs_broken_watchtower.description: A collapsed watchtower, half its height still standing. From the top of what's left, the bridge crossing is fully visible — every safe way across, and every way that isn't.

resource_nodes.name: loose stones scattered through the tower's collapsed base

watchtower_vantage.name: the tower's remaining upper landing
watchtower_vantage.description: Rotted through in two places, but still holds — and still gives the clearest view of the bridge crossing for miles.

stonearch_bridge.name: Stonearch Bridge
stonearch_bridge.description: An ancient stone bridge spanning a gorge no one remembers naming. Half the carvings on its rail have worn past reading.

resource_nodes.name: the stream running through the gorge below
the muddy bank beneath the bridge, pocked with tiny burrows

worn_carvings.name: the bridge's worn rail carvings
worn_carvings.description: Half worn past reading, the other half still legible enough to make out a procession of small figures, all facing the same direction, toward the far bank.

gorge_below.name: the gorge beneath the bridge
gorge_below.description: Looking down, the sound that rises up doesn't quite match falling water — closer to something breathing, slow and even.

stonearch_bridge_far_end.name: The Far End of the Span
stonearch_bridge_far_end.description: Where the bridge finally lets out past the gorge, onto a narrow shelf of rock before the land opens up again. Quieter here — the gorge's sound doesn't carry this far.

far_end_marker.name: a single carved marker stone
far_end_marker.description: Newer than the bridge itself by centuries, but already weathering to match — someone wanted it to look like it had always been here. A small toll-mark is scratched into its base, low enough to miss unless you're looking.

the_weeping_well.name: The Weeping Well
the_weeping_well.description: A well that hasn't run dry in living memory, though no one draws from it anymore. It is always slightly warmer than the air around it.

lockables.name: a sealed stone door low in the well's wall

wells_rim.name: the well's warm stone rim
wells_rim.description: Warm to the touch no matter the season, with a faint hum that seems to rise and fall with no particular rhythm.

door_carvings.name: carvings ringing the sealed stone door
door_carvings.description: Spirals cut deep into the stone, none of them repeating exactly, all of them circling inward toward the door itself.

well_water.name: the water sitting still at the bottom of the well
well_water.description: Clear all the way down, with nothing floating in it and nothing growing on its walls -- water that's sat this long anywhere else would be thick with algae by now.

tavern_cellar.name: The Tavern Cellar
tavern_cellar.description: A low stone cellar beneath the Crossroads Tavern, close with the smell of old wood and older wine.

resource_nodes.name: a patch of pale fungus growing in the damp corner

marked_barrel.name: a barrel with a chalk symbol
marked_barrel.description: Every other barrel down here is unmarked. This one has a circle-and-line symbol chalked on its lid, redrawn recently enough that the dust hasn't settled on it.

cellar_shelf.name: a shelf of dusty bottles
cellar_shelf.description: Vintages going back further than the tavern's own sign out front. A few labels have worn away entirely.

tavern_upstairs.name: The Tavern's Upper Rooms
tavern_upstairs.description: A narrow hallway of guest rooms above the common room, quiet but for the creak of old floorboards.

room_seven_door.name: the door at the end of the hall
room_seven_door.description: Every other guest room door stands slightly ajar or plainly numbered. This one is shut, unmarked, and noticeably colder to stand near than the hallway around it.

guestbook.name: a guestbook on the landing table
guestbook.description: Names going back years, most in different hands. A handful of entries near the middle of the book are scratched out so hard the pen tore the page.

the_arcane_nook.name: The Arcane Nook
the_arcane_nook.description: A gap between two shopfronts on Market Row, barely wide enough to walk through, that most people swear wasn't there yesterday. It always is, if you're looking for it.

vanes_shelves.name: shelves of curiosities behind the counter
vanes_shelves.description: Nothing on them is labeled, and no two items seem to be from the same era, region, or maker — yet somehow none of it looks out of place next to the rest.

the_uneven_floor.name: the shop's oddly uneven floor
the_uneven_floor.description: The floorboards slope gently toward the back of the nook, just enough to notice, never enough to explain.

hollow_verge_threshold.name: The Hollow Verge
hollow_verge_threshold.description: The land past the bridge's far end doesn't just open up -- it keeps opening, further than the shelf of rock should allow, into a grey hush that wasn't visible from the bridge at all. The air feels thinner here, like the world is only half-finished with this part of itself.

half_finished_horizon.name: the horizon, somehow unfinished
half_finished_horizon.description: Where the sky should meet the ground, it just... doesn't, quite. The seam is close enough to see if you don't look at it directly.

hollow_verge_bonefield.name: The Bonefield
hollow_verge_bonefield.description: A field of old bone, sun-grey and half-sunk into the ground, arranged in ranks too even to be an accident. Whatever army this once was, it's still standing in formation, waiting for an order that never came.

standing_ranks.name: the bonefield's standing ranks
standing_ranks.description: Row after row, still in formation after however long this has been. A few ranks nearer the cairn have started, almost imperceptibly, to turn their heads.

hollow_verge_sealed_cairn.name: The Sealed Cairn
hollow_verge_sealed_cairn.description: A low cairn built from the same grey stone as everything else here, sealed with a door that has no visible hinge and no visible lock -- just a single line of script worn nearly smooth, still just legible.

worn_seal_script.name: the cairn's worn seal script
worn_seal_script.description: "I am given back to those who already have everything, and worth nothing to those who have lost it all. What am I?" -- carved deep enough to have survived whatever wore the rest of the stone smooth.

hollow_verge_inner_sanctum.name: The Verge Sanctum
hollow_verge_inner_sanctum.description: The unfinished horizon closes in completely here, until the sanctum itself is the only clearly real thing left standing. Something has been waiting at its center for exactly as long as the field outside has been standing at attention -- and it has finally noticed you.

unfinished_center.name: the sanctum's unfinished center
unfinished_center.description: Not empty, exactly -- more like a space the world hasn't gotten around to deciding what belongs in yet. Right now, that's the Warden.

combat_environment.name: the sanctum's own unfinished boundary
combat_environment.description: The horizon that closes in here isn't just atmosphere -- it's an edge, and edges can be pushed.

hollow_verge_husk_orchard.name: The Husk Orchard
hollow_verge_husk_orchard.description: Rows of something that used to grow here, gone dry and hollow in ranks too even to be a real orchard. Whatever's still walking between the rows remembers being planted.

dry_rows.name: the orchard's dry, even rows
dry_rows.description: Nothing this dead should still be standing this straight.

hollow_verge_ashen_reliquary.name: The Ashen Reliquary
hollow_verge_ashen_reliquary.description: Shelves of grey, ash-fine relics line every wall, none of them quite identifiable, all of them clearly meant to be kept. Something is still chained here, tending to the collection.

ash_fine_shelves.name: the reliquary's ash-fine shelves
ash_fine_shelves.description: Everything on them has been dusted, straightened, and kept, over and over, for longer than anything should have to wait to be looked at again.

hollow_verge_forgotten_nook.name: The Forgotten Nook
hollow_verge_forgotten_nook.description: A side hollow off the bonefield, easy to miss and clearly not meant to be found — nothing here was ever part of the main procession the rest of the Verge seems built around.

overlooked_hollow.name: the overlooked hollow itself
overlooked_hollow.description: Whatever was left here was left in a hurry, by someone who never expected to come back for it.

greymoor_downs_tower_vantage_below.name: Beneath the Vantage
greymoor_downs_tower_vantage_below.description: The watchtower's collapsed base opens further down than it looks from the ridge — whatever's been using the ruin as a perch clearly isn't alone up there.

the_deeper_rubble.name: the tower's deeper rubble
the_deeper_rubble.description: Whatever fell here fell a long time ago. Something's clearly made a den of it since.

greymoor_downs_tower_cellar.name: The Tower Cellar
greymoor_downs_tower_cellar.description: A half-buried storeroom under the watchtower's foundation, easy to miss beneath the rubble — something small has been using it to stay out of the wind.

the_half_buried_stores.name: the cellar's half-buried stores
the_half_buried_stores.description: Whatever was kept down here was abandoned long before anything started denning in it.

stonearch_bridge_the_lower_battlement.name: The Lower Battlement
stonearch_bridge_the_lower_battlement.description: Real fortification, cut into the gorge wall above the bridge -- whoever built this crossing meant to defend it.

stonearch_bridge_the_watch_stair.name: The Watch Stair
stonearch_bridge_the_watch_stair.description: Steps cut straight up the gorge wall, real and deliberate, worn smooth by generations of real boots.

stonearch_bridge_the_sealed_armory.name: The Sealed Armory
stonearch_bridge_the_sealed_armory.description: A real armory, sealed shut since long before anyone alive would remember why.

lockables.name: the sealed armory's own real cache

stonearch_bridge_the_upper_battlement.name: The Upper Battlement
stonearch_bridge_the_upper_battlement.description: Higher fortification, real stonework, the gorge wind loud enough here to cover most other sound.

stonearch_bridge_the_quiet_rampart.name: The Quiet Rampart
stonearch_bridge_the_quiet_rampart.description: A stretch of rampart kept deliberately clear -- the one genuinely calm room this high up the gorge wall.

stonearch_bridge_the_signal_tower.name: The Signal Tower
stonearch_bridge_the_signal_tower.description: A real signal tower, built to be seen from the crossroads -- whoever manned it had a real reason to watch this crossing.

resource_nodes.name: a real ore vein exposed by old stonework

stonearch_bridge_the_carved_gate.name: The Carved Gate
stonearch_bridge_the_carved_gate.description: A real gate, carved with the same worn script as the bridge's own rail -- older than the fortification built around it.

stonearch_bridge_the_gatehouse.name: The Gatehouse
stonearch_bridge_the_gatehouse.description: A real gatehouse, still standing, still real enough to have once housed a real garrison.

gatehouse_garrison_record.name: a real, worn garrison record
gatehouse_garrison_record.description: Names, dates, a real roster -- whoever kept this crossing fortified took it seriously, right up until they clearly stopped needing to.

stonearch_bridge_the_high_guard.name: The High Guard
stonearch_bridge_the_high_guard.description: The highest real guard post on the whole gorge wall -- and something's clearly still standing watch.

stonearch_bridge_the_towers_crown.name: The Tower's Crown
stonearch_bridge_the_towers_crown.description: The very top of the old fortification -- from here, the whole gorge crossing is visible at once.

stonearch_bridge_the_keepers_hall.name: The Keeper's Hall
stonearch_bridge_the_keepers_hall.description: A real hall, built for whoever actually kept this whole fortification -- the last real room before the keep proper.

stonearch_bridge_the_old_keep.name: The Old Keep
stonearch_bridge_the_old_keep.description: The real keep at the top of it all -- and whatever's actually still keeping it has been waiting a long time to be found.

combat_environment.name: the old keep's own real, crumbling battlements
combat_environment.description: Real stone, real age -- fighting hard enough near the edge risks bringing a real piece of the wall down on everyone nearby.

stonearch_bridge_the_armory_annex.name: The Armory Annex
stonearch_bridge_the_armory_annex.description: A small side room off the sealed armory, real weapon racks still standing, mostly empty now.

annex_racks.name: real, mostly-empty weapon racks
annex_racks.description: A few real blades remain, rusted past any use, but placed with real care once.

stonearch_bridge_the_watch_stairs_landin.name: The Watch Stair's Landing
stonearch_bridge_the_watch_stairs_landin.description: A small landing partway up the watch stair, real and deliberate, clearly meant as a resting point.

greymoor_downs_the_vantage_reach.name: The Vantage Reach
greymoor_downs_the_vantage_reach.description: The ridge keeps going east past the vantage point, further than the watchtower's own real sightline should carry.

greymoor_downs_the_windswept_hollow.name: The Windswept Hollow
greymoor_downs_the_windswept_hollow.description: A real hollow in the ridge, wind loud enough here to cover most other sound.

greymoor_downs_the_sheltered_camp.name: The Sheltered Camp
greymoor_downs_the_sheltered_camp.description: A real camp, sheltered from the wind by a fold in the ridge -- the one genuinely calm spot on this whole reach.

resource_nodes.name: a bed of wind-hardy herbs

greymoor_downs_the_ridge_cache.name: The Ridge Cache
greymoor_downs_the_ridge_cache.description: A real cache, tucked into the ridge's own fold, well out of the wind and well out of sight.

lockables.name: a real cache set into the ridge

greymoor_downs_the_far_marker.name: The Far Marker
greymoor_downs_the_far_marker.description: A real boundary marker, older than the watchtower, worn nearly smooth by wind and years.

greymoor_downs_the_markers_riddle.name: The Marker's Riddle
greymoor_downs_the_markers_riddle.description: The far marker's own real inscription, worn but legible if you actually stop to read it.

greymoor_downs_the_deep_reach.name: The Deep Reach
greymoor_downs_the_deep_reach.description: The ridge finally starts to fall away here, real and steep, toward something the wind carries no sound of at all.

greymoor_downs_the_reachs_hollow.name: The Reach's Hollow
greymoor_downs_the_reachs_hollow.description: A real hollow at the edge of the reach, sheltered enough that something's clearly been using it.

reachs_hollow_record.name: a real, worn marker left in the hollow
reachs_hollow_record.description: The same tally style found scratched into a certain dwarf's old gear -- whoever's route this was, it crossed the Downs too.

greymoor_downs_the_ridges_end.name: The Ridge's End
greymoor_downs_the_ridges_end.description: The real end of the ridge, level ground finally opening up -- and something old has clearly claimed it.

greymoor_downs_the_final_watch.name: The Final Watch
greymoor_downs_the_final_watch.description: The real last watch on this whole ridge -- and whatever's kept it has been alone up here for a very long time.

greymoor_downs_the_reachs_overlook.name: The Reach's Overlook
greymoor_downs_the_reachs_overlook.description: A small rise off the vantage reach, real and deliberate, high enough to see most of the ridge at once.

greymoor_downs_the_hollows_lee.name: The Hollow's Lee
greymoor_downs_the_hollows_lee.description: A real lee off the windswept hollow, sheltered enough that something small has been left here.

lockables.name: a real cache tucked into the lee

greymoor_downs_the_markers_shadow.name: The Marker's Shadow
greymoor_downs_the_markers_shadow.description: A small patch of real, permanent shade behind the far marker, out of place on an otherwise open ridge.

greymoor_downs_the_reachs_ledge.name: The Reach's Ledge
greymoor_downs_the_reachs_ledge.description: A real ledge off the deep reach, narrow enough to be genuinely dangerous in a real hurry.

greymoor_downs_the_hollows_record.name: The Hollow's Record
greymoor_downs_the_hollows_record.description: A small side pocket off the reach's hollow, real records left behind by whoever used it as a real waypoint.

greymoor_downs_the_ends_own_marker.name: The End's Own Marker
greymoor_downs_the_ends_own_marker.description: A final real marker, the last one on the whole reach -- someone made sure this line was kept all the way out here too.

stonearch_bridge_the_old_watch.name: The Old Watch
stonearch_bridge_the_old_watch.description: A real, half-collapsed watch post off the bridge's own eastern rail, holding a single deliberately-kept key -- and something has made a den of guarding it.

stonearch_bridge_the_old_vault.name: The Old Vault
stonearch_bridge_the_old_vault.description: Real, deliberate storage built into the bridge's own stonework -- whoever sealed it meant for it to stay that way.

old_vault_marker.name: a marker carved into the vault's own stone
old_vault_marker.description: Whoever sealed this counted on nobody else ever having the key -- and, judging by the dust, nobody ever did until now.

sunken_root_caverns.name: The Sunken Root Caverns
sunken_root_caverns.description: Caves threaded with the pale, massive roots of something above. The air smells faintly of rain that never falls down here.

resource_nodes.name: a vein of Sulfur Dust in the cavern wall
a shelf of pale fungus clinging low to the massive root

massive_root.name: the cavern's massive pale root
massive_root.description: Wide enough to walk along like a bridge. Pressing a hand to it, you'd almost swear it shifts, slow as a held breath.

damp_alcove.name: a damp stone alcove
damp_alcove.description: Old claw marks score the walls here, layered over each other by what must have been years of the same animal returning to the same spot — or several animals never learning better.

goblin_warrens.name: The Goblin Warrens
goblin_warrens.description: A cramped, chattering network of tunnels. Someone, or something, has been organizing the goblins here far better than goblins usually organize themselves.

resource_nodes.name: a seam of Iron Ore the goblins have been chipping at

chalk_markings.name: chalk markings on the tunnel walls
chalk_markings.description: Goblin scrawl, but organized — arrows, tallies, what might be a crude map — in a hand far steadier than goblins are known for. One tally column keeps a running count in coin, not kills.

makeshift_totem.name: a crude bone totem
makeshift_totem.description: Lashed together from bits of scavenged bone and wire, and kept in far better repair than anything else the goblins have bothered to maintain. A few of the wire loops are strung with the same cheap toll-tokens the Blackthorn Raiders hand travelers at Greymoor Downs.

combat_environment.name: the sagging tunnel supports
combat_environment.description: Old timber props groaning under the weight of everything above -- a hard enough blow could bring the roof down on whatever's standing beneath it.

glimmerdeep_grotto.name: Glimmerdeep Grotto
glimmerdeep_grotto.description: Vast caverns lit by crystal formations that pulse very slowly, like something breathing. Some of the crystals have gone a wrong color.

wrong_crystal.name: a crystal pulsing off-rhythm
wrong_crystal.description: Every other formation in the grotto breathes in the same slow unison. This one pulses to its own beat, faintly, and a shade of color none of the others share.

grotto_pool.name: a still, black pool
grotto_pool.description: The water is perfectly still, and reflects the ceiling above — except for one patch, near the center, that seems to reflect something else entirely.

sunken_root_caverns_deep_tunnels.name: The Deep Tunnels
sunken_root_caverns_deep_tunnels.description: Passages that keep going long after they should have ended. Somewhere ahead, rubble chokes one of them almost shut -- almost. A second, narrower gap nearby has been sealed with something far more deliberate than rubble.

tunnel_rubble_choke.name: a passage nearly sealed by old rubble
tunnel_rubble_choke.description: Almost fully collapsed, but not quite — cleared enough times, by something or someone, to still be worth clearing again. Air moves through it from somewhere else entirely. A scrap of oiled cloth, the kind used to keep coin dry underground, is snagged on the rubble's edge.

sunken_root_caverns_forgotten_cistern.name: The Forgotten Cistern
sunken_root_caverns_forgotten_cistern.description: A dry, ancient cistern, long since cut off from whatever it used to hold. Someone stashed something down here and never came back for it.

lockables.name: a sealed cache half-buried in dry silt

cistern_dry_channels.name: the cistern's dry drainage channels
cistern_dry_channels.description: Cut with real precision, leading nowhere any water could reach anymore. Someone built this to hold something other than water.

stashed_toll_crate.name: a crate wedged into a dry alcove
stashed_toll_crate.description: Empty now, but the inside still smells faintly of coin — the same close, metal smell as a toll booth's strongbox, kept somewhere no one would ever think to look for one.

sunken_root_caverns_precise_channel.name: The Precise Channel
sunken_root_caverns_precise_channel.description: A single channel, cut with the same exact precision as the cistern's drainage, leading further down than anything else in these caverns goes. The stonework here isn't goblin work, and it isn't natural either.

channel_matching_stonework.name: stonework that matches something else, somewhere else
channel_matching_stonework.description: The same exact cut, the same exact angle, as stories describe far below the earth in places no one from up here has ever actually seen.

goblin_warrens_inner_den.name: The Inner Den
goblin_warrens_inner_den.description: Deeper into the warrens than most goblins bother going. Whatever discipline holds the outer tunnels together frays out completely back here.

resource_nodes.name: a scatter of unrefined ore the goblins never bothered collecting

den_bone_pile.name: a disorganized pile of gnawed bones
den_bone_pile.description: The one thing back here that ISN'T organized — everything else in these warrens is unnervingly tidy by comparison.

glimmerdeep_grotto_glimmering_pool.name: The Glimmering Pool
glimmerdeep_grotto_glimmering_pool.description: A second, smaller pool tucked behind the grotto's main chamber, lit from below by something buried in the silt at its bottom.

lockables.name: a corroded coffer resting on the pool's floor

resource_nodes.name: faintly glowing moss clinging to the pool's rim

pool_buried_light.name: whatever's glowing at the bottom of the pool
pool_buried_light.description: Too deep to make out clearly, and it never stops glowing, no matter how long you watch it.

the_hush_below.name: The Hush Below
the_hush_below.description: A cavern so silent that your own footsteps seem to arrive a half-second late. Nothing living seems to want to be here, including, increasingly, you.

silent_footprints.name: footprints pressed into old dust
silent_footprints.description: Fresh enough that the dust hasn't resettled, in a size and stride that match no one currently down here.

old_iron_door.name: an old iron door, ajar
old_iron_door.description: Rusted through in places, standing open just enough to see there's nothing but more dark on the other side. It wasn't open a moment ago.

combat_environment.name: a jagged stalactite hanging loose overhead
combat_environment.description: Loose enough that the cavern's own dead silence hasn't been enough to bring it down yet -- but a real shock might finish the job.

the_first_city.name: The First City
the_first_city.description: An impossibly old city, buried and forgotten, built by hands unfamiliar with any craft practiced above. Its central spire is still, somehow, faintly warm.

warm_spire.name: the city's central spire
warm_spire.description: Warm under your palm despite the age and the dark, with the faintest rise and fall to it, like something enormous breathing very slowly.

unfamiliar_glyphs.name: glyphs carved into every visible surface
unfamiliar_glyphs.description: A script that matches nothing above ground, repeated so often it starts to feel less like writing and more like counting.

combat_environment.name: a cracked vent in the spire's warm stone floor
combat_environment.description: Whatever keeps the spire faintly warm vents here too -- crack it open further and it becomes something far less gentle.

the_first_city_outer_ward.name: The Outer Ward
the_first_city_outer_ward.description: A ring of buried structures further out from the spire, walls still standing at odd, deliberate angles no living architect would choose. Whatever lived here built for reasons, not just shelter.

ward_angled_walls.name: walls set at impossible, deliberate angles
ward_angled_walls.description: Every angle is different, and every angle is exact — nothing here is broken or worn, only built strangely on purpose.

the_first_city_spire_reaches.name: The Spire Reaches
the_first_city_spire_reaches.description: The upper reaches of the buried city, close enough to the central spire to feel its warmth without touching it. The glyphs here are denser, and some of them move, slightly, when you're not looking directly at them.

resource_nodes.name: an unnaturally pure vein of ore laced through the stone

reaches_shifting_glyphs.name: a dense cluster of restless glyphs
reaches_shifting_glyphs.description: Watched directly, they hold perfectly still. Watched from the corner of your eye, more than one of them is moving.

the_first_city_sunken_archive.name: The Sunken Archive
the_first_city_sunken_archive.description: A lower level beneath the spire, shelved wall to wall with something that isn't quite paper and isn't quite stone. Whoever built this wanted it remembered, not just recorded.

lockables.name: a sealed vault set into the archive's far wall

archive_endless_shelves.name: shelves stretching further back than the light reaches
archive_endless_shelves.description: Every shelf holds the same repeated shape, over and over, for as far as you can see — counting something, still, long after anyone stopped needing the count.

archive_echoing_recess.name: a recess carved deep into the archive's rear wall
archive_echoing_recess.description: Words carved at its edge, worn but legible: "I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?"

the_first_city_deepest_record.name: The Deepest Record
the_first_city_deepest_record.description: The lowest chamber anyone's found beneath the spire, walls carved floor to ceiling in the same script found everywhere above — except here, for the first time, it isn't repeating. It's telling something.

the_unrepeating_wall.name: the one wall in the whole buried city that doesn't repeat itself
the_unrepeating_wall.description: Every other surface up above counts the same shape over and over. This one, finally, says something different — though no one still living can read it.

lockables.name: a seam in the floor, hidden beneath old dust

the_first_city_forgotten_depth.name: The Forgotten Depth
the_first_city_forgotten_depth.description: Past the seam in the floor, the carved script gives up its shape completely — the walls here are smooth, black, and warm, like something that stopped bothering to explain itself a long time ago.

combat_environment.name: the smooth black walls themselves
combat_environment.description: Warm in a way stone shouldn't be -- disturbed hard enough, they answer back.

whispering_wood_root_hollow.name: The Root Hollow
whispering_wood_root_hollow.description: A hollow beneath the Bramble Thicket's roots, ceiling laced with pale tendrils still faintly warm to the touch. The air smells of turned earth.

resource_nodes.name: a thin seam of ore threading through the roots

hollow_root_lattice.name: the lattice of roots overhead
hollow_root_lattice.description: Every root bends the same direction, all of them curving down and inward, toward wherever the den lies further in.

whispering_wood_sunken_den.name: The Sunken Den
whispering_wood_sunken_den.description: A low, wide den at the end of the roots, floor packed hard by years of restless pacing. Whatever den this is hasn't been abandoned long.

den_claw_marks.name: deep claw marks scored into the packed earth
den_claw_marks.description: Layered thick, over and over, always at the same height — whatever left them never grew any smaller.

whispering_wood_deeper_roots.name: The Deeper Roots
whispering_wood_deeper_roots.description: Past the den, the roots stop looking like roots. They're too regular, too deliberate — less like something that grew here and more like something that was built to look grown.

the_regular_growth.name: a stretch of unnaturally regular root-work
the_regular_growth.description: Every join is the same angle. Whatever grew this whole forest from below, it wasn't growing at random.

greymoor_downs_sunken_barrow.name: The Sunken Barrow
greymoor_downs_sunken_barrow.description: A real camp, still warm in places, dug into the hillside below the Downs — the cold campsite up top was never anything but bait for anyone who stopped looking too soon.

barrow_supply_cache.name: a hidden supply cache dug into the barrow wall
barrow_supply_cache.description: Recently restocked, by the look of it. Whoever uses this place isn't finished with it yet.

stonearch_bridge_gorge_depths.name: The Gorge Depths
stonearch_bridge_gorge_depths.description: The bottom of the gorge beneath the bridge, close and dark, the air moving in and out on a slow rhythm that has nothing to do with wind.

depths_breathing_wall.name: a wide stretch of rock wall, faintly warm
depths_breathing_wall.description: It rises and falls under your palm, slow and even — the same rhythm audible from the bridge far above, only close enough now to feel.

worn_footpath.name: a worn footpath near the rubble-choked passage
worn_footpath.description: Boot prints, pressed into the dust again and again by the same few feet, all leading the same direction — toward the Downs, not away from them.

stonearch_bridge_deep_current.name: The Deep Current
stonearch_bridge_deep_current.description: Where the gorge's water finally goes, funneled into a current that runs somewhere no map accounts for. It runs toward the same distant, slow rhythm that fills the depths above.

the_vanishing_current.name: the current itself, vanishing into darker water
the_vanishing_current.description: It never resurfaces anywhere anyone's mapped. Wherever it's actually going, it's going somewhere with purpose.

wordless_choir_gate.name: The Wordless Gate
wordless_choir_gate.description: Past where The Unrepeating finally stopped, the black walls open into something that was never meant to be walked through twice -- not a door, exactly, more like the held breath before whatever this place used to say.

held_breath.name: the held breath in the stone
held_breath.description: Not a sound, not quite silence either -- the specific quiet of something about to speak that never quite does.

wordless_choir_machinery.name: The Still Machinery
wordless_choir_machinery.description: Vast shapes stand silent in ranks, built for a purpose no one living was ever told. Whatever they once made — sound, meaning, both — they stopped making it so long ago that stillness is the only thing they do well anymore.

silent_ranks.name: the machinery's silent ranks
silent_ranks.description: Row after row of shapes built to carry something further than a voice alone ever could. None of them have moved in longer than anyone down here has been able to count.

wordless_choir_hall.name: The Choir Hall
wordless_choir_hall.description: A chamber shaped like a throat, built to carry a single note to every corner at once. It hasn't held one in longer than anything else down here has been keeping time.

throat_shaped_walls.name: the hall's throat-shaped walls
throat_shaped_walls.description: "Every voice down here says the same thing until it reaches me, and then it says nothing at all. What am I?" -- the shape of the question is carved into the curve of the walls themselves, the answer nowhere in sight.

wordless_choir_source.name: The Source
wordless_choir_source.description: Where the hall's shape finally resolves into a single point, something is still, impossibly, humming — a note too low to hear and too old to have ever had a name.

impossible_hum.name: the impossible, wordless hum
impossible_hum.description: Not a sound you hear so much as one you stop, for a moment, being able to not hear. It has been going on, unheard, for exactly as long as everything above it has been standing still.

combat_environment.name: the impossibly low, impossibly old note itself
combat_environment.description: A note too low to hear and too old to have ever really stopped -- forcing it to resolve, even for a moment, isn't quiet.

wordless_choir_antechamber.name: The Antechamber
wordless_choir_antechamber.description: A narrow space between the gate and whatever lies beyond it, built the way a held breath is built — meant to be passed through, never meant to be stayed in.

held_breath_walls.name: the antechamber's held-breath walls
held_breath_walls.description: Not quite narrow enough to be a corridor, not quite wide enough to be a room -- built for passing through, not for staying.

wordless_choir_resonance_well.name: The Resonance Well
wordless_choir_resonance_well.description: A shaft that seems to answer back, faintly, if you're quiet long enough to notice — the same note, over and over, from somewhere too far down to actually be there.

the_answering_shaft.name: the well's answering shaft
the_answering_shaft.description: Drop anything down it and you'll hear it land twice -- once from below, and once, a half-second later, from somewhere that isn't below at all.

wordless_choir_forgotten_chord.name: The Forgotten Chord
wordless_choir_forgotten_chord.description: A side hollow off the still machinery, easy to miss between two of the silent ranks — whatever used to happen here was never part of the main performance.

unused_alcove.name: the unused alcove
unused_alcove.description: Built for something that never got scheduled -- or already happened, once, a very long time before anyone was around to hear it.

goblin_warrens_supply_tunnel.name: The Supply Tunnel
goblin_warrens_supply_tunnel.description: A narrow tunnel stacked with crates and stolen sacks, guarded better than the entrance ever was — whoever's really running this warren clearly cares more about what's down here.

stacked_crates.name: the tunnel's stacked crates
stacked_crates.description: Better guarded than anything at the entrance -- whatever's inside them, someone thinks it's worth protecting.

goblin_warrens_deep_larder.name: The Deep Larder
goblin_warrens_deep_larder.description: Past the inner den, a low chamber packed floor to ceiling with hoarded supplies — enough to keep a much bigger warren fed than the one anyone's actually seen so far.

hoarded_supplies.name: the larder's hoarded supplies
hoarded_supplies.description: Whoever's stockpiling all this was planning for a much longer siege than the one that's actually happened so far.

goblin_warrens_collapsed_tunnel.name: The Collapsed Tunnel
goblin_warrens_collapsed_tunnel.description: A side passage caved in long before the goblins ever moved in — most of it's rubble now, but something's clearly still squatting in what's left of it.

old_cave_in.name: the old cave-in
old_cave_in.description: Whatever caused this happened long before any goblin ever set foot down here.

sunken_root_caverns_flooded_gallery.name: The Flooded Gallery
sunken_root_caverns_flooded_gallery.description: Ankle-deep water covers the floor here, black with root-rot and disturbed constantly by something moving through it just out of sight.

root_rot_water.name: the root-rotted floodwater
root_rot_water.description: Black enough that whatever's moving through it never actually breaks the surface to be seen.

sunken_root_caverns_hollow_wellspring.name: The Hollow Wellspring
sunken_root_caverns_hollow_wellspring.description: Past the channel, the water finally pools somewhere real — a wellspring sunk so deep that whatever drinks from it hasn't seen the surface in longer than anyone's kept track.

the_deep_pool.name: the wellspring's deep, still pool
the_deep_pool.description: Whatever lives down here has clearly been drinking from the same water for a very long time.

sunken_root_caverns_side_pool.name: The Side Pool
sunken_root_caverns_side_pool.description: A smaller offshoot of the flooded gallery, easy to wade past without noticing — something small has been squatting here, well out of the way of the main tunnels.

shallow_offshoot.name: the shallow offshoot itself
shallow_offshoot.description: Barely deep enough to be worth calling a pool at all -- which is probably exactly why nothing's bothered clearing it out.

stonearch_bridge_web_hollow.name: The Web Hollow
stonearch_bridge_web_hollow.description: A hollow in the gorge wall gone almost entirely to silk — layer over layer of it, thick enough that whatever's still spinning down here has clearly had a long time to work.

layered_silk.name: the hollow's layered silk
layered_silk.description: Thick enough in places to walk on -- if you were willing to find out the hard way whether that's actually true.

stonearch_bridge_undertow.name: The Undertow
stonearch_bridge_undertow.description: Past the deep current, the water finally drags at something solid — a den built low against the pull, exactly where nothing swept downstream would ever be able to climb back out.

the_dragging_pull.name: the undertow's dragging pull
the_dragging_pull.description: Everything that's ever gone into the deep current from up above ends up here eventually. Most of it doesn't leave again.

stonearch_bridge_silked_nook.name: The Silked Nook
stonearch_bridge_silked_nook.description: A narrow gap in the web hollow's silk, easy to miss — something small has been left here to grow, well away from the rest of the brood.

the_narrow_gap.name: the silk's narrow gap
the_narrow_gap.description: Barely big enough to squeeze into -- which is probably exactly why something small chose it.

greymoor_downs_barrow_depths.name: The Barrow Depths
greymoor_downs_barrow_depths.description: Past the sunken barrow's supply cache, the hillside opens into a real den — deeper, older, and considerably less willing to share its territory.

the_real_den.name: the depths' real den
the_real_den.description: The camp up above was never anything but bait. This is where whoever's actually in charge down here has been living the whole time.

greymoor_downs_below_the_cairn.name: Below the Cairn
greymoor_downs_below_the_cairn.description: A narrow shaft under the cairn's foundation stone, dug by hand and refilled by hand, over and over, by whoever keeps coming back. Nothing down here looks like it's resting.

the_refilled_shaft.name: the shaft's carefully refilled walls
the_refilled_shaft.description: Packed and re-packed so many times the dirt's gone smooth. Somebody keeps digging this back open, and somebody keeps closing it again.

the_wedged_marker.name: a weather-stained marker, wedged sideways into the shaft wall
the_wedged_marker.description: Not local stone — carried here, then left. Scratched into its face, in a hand that matches nothing else down here, is a story about someone called Pandora, who was given a box she never asked for and told only that she must never open it — and who spent the rest of her life proving that being told 'never' isn't the same as being told 'why.' The marker doesn't say what was inside. It doesn't say she opened it, either. It just says she kept the box, and kept asking, until the day she didn't need an answer anymore. Nothing else here explains why it's buried under a cairn on the far side of a world it clearly wasn't carved in.

greymoor_downs_the_unopened_seal.name: The Unopened Seal
greymoor_downs_the_unopened_seal.description: Past the shaft's carefully refilled walls, past the marker no one still living can properly read, the digging finally reaches something that was never dirt to begin with — a seal, still closed, exactly the way it was left. Whoever kept coming back down here never actually opened it. They just kept checking that it hadn't opened itself.

the_seal_itself.name: the still-closed seal
the_seal_itself.description: "Everyone who opens me finds exactly what they were afraid of, and exactly what they needed. What am I?" -- worn into the seal's face in the same hand as the marker up above, in a script that has, somehow, gotten easier to read the further down you've come.

greymoor_downs_the_last_question.name: The Last Question
greymoor_downs_the_last_question.description: Whatever the seal was built to keep in is, impossibly, still exactly what was sealed in the first place — old beyond the world it's buried under, patient beyond every name anyone's ever given the things that came after it, and, for the first time in longer than waiting has meant anything, finally about to be asked something back.

the_thing_itself.name: the thing the seal was built to hold
the_thing_itself.description: Every quiet, patient, waiting thing you've ever fought before this was wearing a piece of this. This is the whole of it, finally in one place.

whispering_wood_hollow_threshold.name: The Hollow Threshold
whispering_wood_hollow_threshold.description: The passage between the den and whatever's past the deeper roots narrows here to almost nothing — easy to defend, and clearly being defended.

the_narrow_passage.name: the threshold's narrow passage
the_narrow_passage.description: Barely wide enough for one at a time -- which is clearly exactly the point.

whispering_wood_stray_den.name: The Stray Den
whispering_wood_stray_den.description: A smaller den branching off the threshold, half-collapsed and clearly not the pack's main territory — something's still using it anyway.

the_half_collapsed_den.name: the half-collapsed den
the_half_collapsed_den.description: Too small and too damaged to be worth the main pack's time -- which is probably exactly why something's still squatting in it.

whispering_wood_deep_root_chamber.name: The Deep Root Chamber
whispering_wood_deep_root_chamber.description: Past the deeper roots, the regular, deliberate root-work finally resolves into an actual chamber — built, not grown, by something that clearly wanted this exact shape.

the_deliberate_chamber.name: the chamber's deliberate shape
the_deliberate_chamber.description: Nothing about this room happened by accident. Whatever wanted it built this way, it clearly still wants it kept that way.

glimmerdeep_grotto_buried_glow.name: The Buried Glow
glimmerdeep_grotto_buried_glow.description: Past the glimmering pool, whatever's buried in the silt finally surfaces enough to see — barely — and it's not alone down here anymore.

the_surfacing_light.name: the light finally surfacing from the silt
the_surfacing_light.description: Close enough to see now that it's clearly not a crystal at all -- just something that glows like one.

glimmerdeep_grotto_dim_hollow.name: The Dim Hollow
glimmerdeep_grotto_dim_hollow.description: A narrow side-hollow off the glimmering pool, lit only by whatever light bleeds through from the crystals nearby — dim enough that something small has made a home of it.

the_bled_light.name: the hollow's bled-through light
the_bled_light.description: Just enough to see by, and clearly just enough to live by too.

wrathflame_vault_threshold.name: The Sealed Threshold
wrathflame_vault_threshold.description: The stone beneath the shrine gives way to a passage that's clearly been sealed on purpose, not collapsed by accident. The air here is already warmer than it has any right to be.

wrathflame_vault_ember_hall.name: The Ember Hall
wrathflame_vault_ember_hall.description: A long hall lit only by embers set into the walls, none of them burning anything that still exists. A warded iron door bars a passage to the west.

wrathflame_vault_bellows_chamber.name: The Bellows Chamber
wrathflame_vault_bellows_chamber.description: A side chamber built around a huge, ancient bellows that hasn't drawn breath in a very long time. Something was left here in a hurry.

the_old_bellows.name: the ancient bellows
the_old_bellows.description: Cold, but the leather hasn't rotted the way it should have by now.

wrathflame_vault_ash_gallery.name: The Ash Gallery
wrathflame_vault_ash_gallery.description: Ash drifts here that never seems to settle, stirred by heat with no visible source.

wrathflame_vault_ember_font.name: The Ember Font
wrathflame_vault_ember_font.description: A single, small spring bubbles here, warm rather than scalding -- the one genuinely safe room this deep in.

ember_font_spring.name: a warm, clear spring
ember_font_spring.description: Drinking from it settles something in your chest you didn't know was unsettled. The one genuinely calm spot this deep in the vault.

ember_font_shrine.name: a small worn shrine
ember_font_shrine.description: Old enough that no one remembers who it was built for. It still feels like it's listening.

wrathflame_vault_smoldering_stair.name: The Smoldering Stair
wrathflame_vault_smoldering_stair.description: Steps that radiate heat upward with every one you descend, like the vault itself is breathing. The warded door back to the hall stands closed behind you until you open it again.

wrathflame_vault_deep_forge.name: The Deep Forge
wrathflame_vault_deep_forge.description: A real forge, still intact, still faintly warm at the coals -- whoever worked here left mid-task and never came back.

resource_nodes.name: a rich, heat-blackened ore vein

wrathflame_vault_cinder_archive.name: The Cinder Archive
wrathflame_vault_cinder_archive.description: Shelves of scorched, half-legible records -- someone was keeping track of this place, once, and stopped without warning.

scorched_record.name: a scorched record shelf
scorched_record.description: The legible fragments all say the same thing in different words: whatever's sealed below was never meant to wake on its own.

wrathflame_vault_inner_seal.name: The Inner Seal
wrathflame_vault_inner_seal.description: The last real door in the vault, standing open -- whatever used to hold it shut gave way a long time before anyone arrived.

wrathflame_vault_sanctum.name: The Wrathflame Sanctum
wrathflame_vault_sanctum.description: The heat here isn't ambient anymore -- it's coming from something that's very much still awake, and has been for a long time.

deep_root_vault_threshold.name: The Ringed Threshold
deep_root_vault_threshold.description: The ground beneath the mushroom ring opens onto a passage that clearly wasn't dug by anything with hands.

deep_root_vault_spore_hollow.name: The Spore Hollow
deep_root_vault_spore_hollow.description: A wide pocket thick with drifting spores, branching off in three real directions -- and something has sealed a fourth passage shut with hardened root-resin.

deep_root_vault_choking_hollow.name: The Choking Hollow
deep_root_vault_choking_hollow.description: A tight side pocket, thick with spores -- something was dragged in here and never dragged back out.

deep_root_vault_bramble_maze.name: The Bramble Maze
deep_root_vault_bramble_maze.description: Roots knot into walls here, thick enough to be architecture rather than plant growth.

deep_root_vault_weeping_spring.name: The Weeping Spring
deep_root_vault_weeping_spring.description: Clean water somehow finds its way down here, untouched by anything growing around it -- the one real safe room in the vault.

weeping_spring_water.name: a clean, cold spring
weeping_spring_water.description: Untouched by anything else growing down here. Drinking it clears your head.

weeping_spring_shrine.name: a moss-covered shrine stone
weeping_spring_shrine.description: Someone kept this clear of the bramble for a very long time, on purpose.

deep_root_vault_sentinel_hollow.name: The Sentinel Hollow
deep_root_vault_sentinel_hollow.description: Something stands here that used to be alive, root-fused into the wall, still facing the way in. The root door back to the hollow stands closed behind you until you open it again.

deep_root_vault_husk_gallery.name: The Husk Gallery
deep_root_vault_husk_gallery.description: Rows of hollowed-out husks line the walls, each one shaped like it used to be something else.

resource_nodes.name: a cluster of rare bitter-root herbs

hollowed_husk_row.name: a row of hollowed husks
hollowed_husk_row.description: Whatever these used to be, the shape is closer to person than plant.

deep_root_vault_elder_root_chamber.name: The Elder Root Chamber
deep_root_vault_elder_root_chamber.description: One single root, older and thicker than every other one in this vault combined, runs wall to wall through here.

deep_root_vault_last_root.name: The Last Root
deep_root_vault_last_root.description: The elder root finally ends here, or starts here -- it's genuinely unclear which direction it was ever growing.

deep_root_vault_deepest_memory.name: The Deepest Memory
deep_root_vault_deepest_memory.description: Everything down here feels remembered rather than real -- like the vault itself is playing something back.

playback_root.name: a root pulsing faintly, in a rhythm
playback_root.description: It isn't growing. It's remembering something on a loop, and hasn't reached the end of it yet.

deep_root_vault_sanctum.name: The Root Sanctum
deep_root_vault_sanctum.description: The oldest root in the Whispering Wood ends here, or begins here -- and it has clearly been waiting.

the_first_city_forgotten_ward.name: The Forgotten Ward
the_first_city_forgotten_ward.description: Buildings here have fully lost whatever shape they were built in -- just angles now, repeated without any obvious plan.

the_first_city_collapsed_row.name: The Collapsed Row
the_first_city_collapsed_row.description: An entire street's worth of structures folded in on themselves at once, all in the same direction.

the_first_city_sealed_vault_row.name: The Sealed Vault Row
the_first_city_sealed_vault_row.description: A short row of what used to be storerooms, one of them still sealed shut against everything that's happened since.

the_first_city_silent_market.name: The Silent Market
the_first_city_silent_market.description: Stalls still stand in careful rows, every single one of them empty. Someone else has clearly been through here recently, on purpose.

empty_market_stalls.name: rows of empty market stalls
empty_market_stalls.description: Whoever cleared these out did it carefully, not in a panic.

the_first_city_watchers_walk.name: Watcher's Walk
the_first_city_watchers_walk.description: A single carved figure lines this whole passage, repeated exactly, watching every direction at once.

the_first_city_spire_stair.name: The Spire Stair
the_first_city_spire_stair.description: Steps spiral up around the spire's own core, closer to whatever keeps it faintly warm with every turn.

resource_nodes.name: a warm, glyph-etched ore seam

the_first_city_spire_overlook.name: The Spire Overlook
the_first_city_spire_overlook.description: High enough to see the shape of the whole buried city at once -- it was clearly a real city, once, laid out with real intent.

overlook_true_shape.name: the true shape of the city, seen from here
overlook_true_shape.description: From up here it's obvious this was never a ruin by accident -- something made a very deliberate choice to bury it.

the_first_city_spire_crown.name: The Spire Crown
the_first_city_spire_crown.description: The very top of the spire, sealed off from the sky above by more stone than should be structurally possible.

the_first_city_forgotten_vault.name: The Forgotten Vault
the_first_city_forgotten_vault.description: A storage chamber below even the Deepest Record -- whatever was kept here was worth burying twice.

resource_nodes.name: a rich, undisturbed ore seam

the_first_city_the_unwritten_hall.name: The Unwritten Hall
the_first_city_the_unwritten_hall.description: Every other wall in this city is covered edge to edge in script. This one, alone, is completely bare.

the_first_city_the_counted_door.name: The Counted Door
the_first_city_the_counted_door.description: A door with real, deliberate tally marks carved beside it -- someone was counting something every time they passed through.

lockables.name: a small cache tucked beside the tally marks

the_first_city_borins_old_ward.name: The Old Watch Post
the_first_city_borins_old_ward.description: A guard post, real and deliberately built, standing at odds with everything else down here -- someone from the surface world stood watch here once.

old_watch_post_marks.name: worn marks on the old post's stone sill
old_watch_post_marks.description: Whoever stood watch here counted the days a very specific way -- the same tally style you've seen scratched into a certain dwarf's old gear.

the_first_city_last_archive.name: The Last Archive
the_first_city_last_archive.description: A final, small room of records, quieter than the Sunken Archive above -- the one genuinely calm room this deep in.

last_archive_final_shelf.name: the one shelf that isn't repeating itself
last_archive_final_shelf.description: Every other shelf in this city counts the same thing over and over. This one is the only place that seems to be building toward something instead.

the_first_city_the_final_count.name: The Final Count
the_first_city_the_final_count.description: The counting stops here -- whatever kept tally this whole way down has clearly finished.

the_first_city_the_original_spire.name: The Original Spire
the_first_city_the_original_spire.description: The real spire, the one every buried copy above was built to imitate -- and the thing that's been repeating itself through this whole city is finally, completely awake.

combat_environment.name: the original spire's own unraveling glyphwork
combat_environment.description: The carved script covering every surface here starts repeating itself faster and faster the longer the fight goes on, until the stone itself can't hold the shape anymore.

goblin_warrens_deeper_rubble.name: The Deeper Rubble
goblin_warrens_deeper_rubble.description: The cave-in goes back much further than anyone squatting near the entrance ever bothered to dig.

goblin_warrens_the_old_seam.name: The Old Seam
goblin_warrens_the_old_seam.description: A real, deliberate seam in the rock, cut by tools no goblin in this warren has ever owned.

goblin_warrens_the_sealed_cache.name: The Sealed Cache
goblin_warrens_the_sealed_cache.description: A cache sealed shut long before goblins ever knew this tunnel existed.

lockables.name: the sealed cache set into the old seam

goblin_warrens_the_forgotten_bore.name: The Forgotten Bore
goblin_warrens_the_forgotten_bore.description: A wide, quiet bore-hole, untouched by the chaos further back -- the one genuinely calm room on this whole side.

goblin_warrens_the_ancient_shaft.name: The Ancient Shaft
goblin_warrens_the_ancient_shaft.description: A shaft sunk straight down, real and deliberate, long before this warren had a name.

resource_nodes.name: a real, untouched ore vein

goblin_warrens_the_buried_threshold.name: The Buried Threshold
goblin_warrens_the_buried_threshold.description: A real threshold, carved, standing at the bottom of the shaft -- whatever's past it was built to be found, eventually, by someone.

goblin_warrens_the_reverent_hollow.name: The Reverent Hollow
goblin_warrens_the_reverent_hollow.description: Goblin markings cover the walls here, arranged with real, uncharacteristic care -- something down here gets treated like it matters.

reverent_hollow_markings.name: careful markings covering every wall
reverent_hollow_markings.description: Goblins drew these, but not like goblins usually draw anything -- slow, repeated, deliberate, like a ritual instead of graffiti.

goblin_warrens_the_idol_chamber.name: The Idol Chamber
goblin_warrens_the_idol_chamber.description: Goblins have propped something up here and started worshipping it without any real idea what it actually is.

goblin_warrens_the_unread_stack.name: The Unread Stack
goblin_warrens_the_unread_stack.description: Shelves, real ones, holding something that isn't quite paper and isn't quite stone -- exactly like the First City's own archive, and just as undisturbed.

unread_stack_shelves.name: shelves of the same unreadable script
unread_stack_shelves.description: The goblins never learned to read it. Neither, most likely, did whoever built the warren over top of it, generations later.

goblin_warrens_the_archive_threshold.name: The Archive Threshold
goblin_warrens_the_archive_threshold.description: The real entrance to whatever this place actually was, before it was ever a warren.

goblin_warrens_the_buried_archive.name: The Buried Archive
goblin_warrens_the_buried_archive.description: Older than the First City's own archive, and every bit as real -- whatever's still whole down here has been waiting a very long time to be found again.

goblin_warrens_the_counting_hall.name: The Counting Hall
goblin_warrens_the_counting_hall.description: More of the same careful chalk tallies from the entrance, thicker here, covering every wall floor to ceiling.

counting_hall_tallies.name: chalk tallies covering every wall
counting_hall_tallies.description: The same running coin-count from the entrance, kept going for a much longer stretch than anyone casually passing through would ever need to.

goblin_warrens_the_second_stash.name: The Second Stash
goblin_warrens_the_second_stash.description: A stash better hidden than the one in the Deep Larder, meant for someone who was never going to be a goblin.

lockables.name: a stash better hidden than the rest

goblin_warrens_the_paymasters_route.name: The Paymaster's Route
goblin_warrens_the_paymasters_route.description: A route worn smooth by real, regular foot traffic -- someone's been walking this exact path for a long time, on a real schedule.

goblin_warrens_the_quiet_crossing.name: The Quiet Crossing
goblin_warrens_the_quiet_crossing.description: A wide, still crossing, deliberately kept clear -- the one genuinely calm room this deep into the ledger's trail.

goblin_warrens_the_grasping_hollow.name: The Grasping Hollow
goblin_warrens_the_grasping_hollow.description: A wide hollow, iron rings still bolted into the rock -- built to hold something a lot bigger than a goblin.

resource_nodes.name: a vein of iron, half-mined already

goblin_warrens_grasks_old_cage.name: The Old Cage
goblin_warrens_grasks_old_cage.description: A cage, real iron, still standing -- the bars bent outward at the bottom, not cut, like something simply forced its own way through.

grasks_bent_bars.name: iron bars, bent outward from the inside
grasks_bent_bars.description: This is where they kept him. The bend in the bars isn't a break -- it's a real dragonborn's own strength, applied slowly, for as long as it took. Grask goes quiet looking at it, then says, flatly, that he's not going back in. Nobody asks him to.

goblin_warrens_the_ledger_vault.name: The Ledger Vault
goblin_warrens_the_ledger_vault.description: A real vault, kept for records instead of gold -- every debt this warren's real paymaster is owed, written down somewhere in here.

goblin_warrens_the_toll_masters_den.name: The Toll Master's Den
goblin_warrens_the_toll_masters_den.description: Whoever actually runs this warren's finances keeps their own den here, well guarded, well away from the goblins they're using.

goblin_warrens_the_final_ledger.name: The Final Ledger
goblin_warrens_the_final_ledger.description: One last real ledger, more detailed than all the others -- and the very last entry in it is dated after today.

final_ledger_last_entry.name: the ledger's very last entry
final_ledger_last_entry.description: Every other entry lists coin, dates, names of dead goblins. The last one is different -- just a single line, in the same steady hand as everything else: "paid in full, whether they know it or not." Whoever's really been funding this warren clearly isn't worried about being found. They're just not here.

goblin_warrens_the_paymasters_approach.name: The Paymaster's Approach
goblin_warrens_the_paymasters_approach.description: The last real stretch before whoever's actually in charge down here -- quiet, deliberate, and clearly meant to be crossed alone.

goblin_warrens_the_true_paymaster.name: The True Paymaster's Den
goblin_warrens_the_true_paymaster.description: The real seat of whatever's been running this warren all along -- and it's been expecting company for a while now.

combat_environment.name: the den's own scattered ledgers and coin
combat_environment.description: Every real page and coin in the room gets kicked up into the fight sooner or later -- none of it enough to slow anything down, all of it enough to be a real hazard underfoot.

goblin_warrens_the_forgotten_landing.name: The Forgotten Landing
goblin_warrens_the_forgotten_landing.description: A small landing off the main crossing, clearly used once as a real waypoint and then abandoned once the route further in was finished.

forgotten_landing_marks.name: old waypoint marks scratched into the stone
forgotten_landing_marks.description: Whoever cut this route first rested here, before the deeper tunnels past the crossing were ever finished.

sunken_root_caverns_the_cleared_choke.name: The Cleared Choke
sunken_root_caverns_the_cleared_choke.description: The rubble that used to choke this passage almost shut has clearly been cleared, on purpose, more than once.

sunken_root_caverns_the_smugglers_cut.name: The Smuggler's Cut
sunken_root_caverns_the_smugglers_cut.description: A real, deliberate cut through the rock, wide enough for someone carrying real cargo -- not a goblin tunnel at all.

sunken_root_caverns_the_hidden_cache.name: The Hidden Cache
sunken_root_caverns_the_hidden_cache.description: A real cache, tucked well out of sight of the main cut -- exactly the kind of place a smuggler would actually use.

sunken_root_caverns_the_root_stair.name: The Root Stair
sunken_root_caverns_the_root_stair.description: Roots have grown into real, deliberate steps here, thick enough to actually climb down.

sunken_root_caverns_the_quiet_pool.name: The Quiet Pool
sunken_root_caverns_the_quiet_pool.description: Real, still water, untouched by the rot further back -- the one genuinely calm room on this whole side.

resource_nodes.name: a bed of real, unrotted herbs

sunken_root_caverns_the_marked_root.name: The Marked Root
sunken_root_caverns_the_marked_root.description: A single massive root, marked with the same toll-tokens found strung on the goblin warrens' own totem.

marked_root_tokens.name: toll-tokens strung along the root
marked_root_tokens.description: The same cheap tokens the Blackthorn Raiders hand travelers at Greymoor Downs, this far from any road -- whoever's running this route reports somewhere real.

sunken_root_caverns_wrens_old_grove.name: The Old Grove
sunken_root_caverns_wrens_old_grove.description: Real, growing things down here too, further from any real light than the isle's own floating garden -- something has clearly been tending this.

old_grove_tending.name: a grove someone's clearly still tending
old_grove_tending.description: Wren stops here longer than anywhere else in the caverns. "This shouldn't still be alive," she says, quiet, kneeling by a root that's threaded itself into a shape too deliberate to be an accident. "Someone's been keeping it this way. Recently." She doesn't say who she thinks did.

sunken_root_caverns_the_tangled_hollow.name: The Tangled Hollow
sunken_root_caverns_the_tangled_hollow.description: Roots knot so tightly here they form real walls -- something grown, not built, and clearly still growing.

sunken_root_caverns_the_deeper_current.name: The Deeper Current
sunken_root_caverns_the_deeper_current.description: The water here moves with real purpose, faster than anything upstream should allow.

sunken_root_caverns_the_last_crossing.name: The Last Crossing
sunken_root_caverns_the_last_crossing.description: The last real crossing before whatever's actually running this smuggling route in person.

sunken_root_caverns_the_smugglers_end.name: The Smuggler's End
sunken_root_caverns_the_smugglers_end.description: The route finally ends here, well guarded, well away from anything a goblin would ever think to defend.

sunken_root_caverns_the_spring_stair.name: The Spring Stair
sunken_root_caverns_the_spring_stair.description: Water runs down these steps in a real, steady sheet, colder the further down it goes.

sunken_root_caverns_the_second_pool.name: The Second Pool
sunken_root_caverns_the_second_pool.description: A second real pool, fed by the same spring, hidden well enough that most people never find it.

lockables.name: a cache sunk into the second pool

sunken_root_caverns_the_deep_current.name: The Deep Current
sunken_root_caverns_the_deep_current.description: The water moves with real force here, deep enough that the bottom's never actually been seen.

sunken_root_caverns_the_kept_shrine.name: The Kept Shrine
sunken_root_caverns_the_kept_shrine.description: A real shrine, kept clean and lit by something that isn't a torch -- the one genuinely still room this deep in the caverns.

kept_shrine_spring.name: a real, clear spring set into the shrine floor
kept_shrine_spring.description: Colder than anything else this deep down, and somehow completely still.

kept_shrine_stone.name: a worn shrine stone
kept_shrine_stone.description: Kept clean by hands that clearly come back to it, again and again.

sunken_root_caverns_the_shrines_after.name: Past the Kept Shrine
sunken_root_caverns_the_shrines_after.description: Whatever just happened at the shrine behind you, the caverns ahead don't care -- they keep going, the same as always.

shrines_after_warmth.name: a spot on the stone still faintly warm
shrines_after_warmth.description: Whoever was kneeling here left in a hurry. Nothing else down here explains a warm patch of stone.

sunken_root_caverns_the_flooded_stair.name: The Flooded Stair
sunken_root_caverns_the_flooded_stair.description: Real steps, real flooding, deep enough now to be a genuine hazard for anyone who isn't careful.

sunken_root_caverns_the_drowned_hall.name: The Drowned Hall
sunken_root_caverns_the_drowned_hall.description: A real hall, fully flooded, the water somehow clear enough to see the whole shape of it from the entrance.

resource_nodes.name: a vein of ore, fully submerged

sunken_root_caverns_the_hollow_beneath.name: The Hollow Beneath
sunken_root_caverns_the_hollow_beneath.description: A small hollow beneath the drowned hall's own floor, dry against every odd.

hollow_beneath_note.name: a real, dry record left in the one dry spot for miles
hollow_beneath_note.description: Someone found this hollow and used it exactly once, for exactly this -- a single note, unsigned: "the roots keep better secrets than people do."

sunken_root_caverns_the_wellsprings_answ.name: The Wellspring's Answer
sunken_root_caverns_the_wellsprings_answ.description: The drowned hall's water finally answers back here, in a rhythm too deliberate to be natural.

sunken_root_caverns_the_final_current.name: The Final Current
sunken_root_caverns_the_final_current.description: The last real current before whatever's actually keeping all of this -- fast, cold, and clearly guarding something.

sunken_root_caverns_the_last_root.name: The Last Root
sunken_root_caverns_the_last_root.description: The very last real root in the whole system ends here, thick as a wall, older than everything around it.

sunken_root_caverns_the_deepest_approach.name: The Deepest Approach
sunken_root_caverns_the_deepest_approach.description: The last real stretch before whatever's actually kept down here this whole time -- quiet, cold, and clearly not empty.

sunken_root_caverns_the_source.name: The Source
sunken_root_caverns_the_source.description: Every current in these caverns starts here -- and whatever's actually keeping it moving has been waiting a very long time to be found.

combat_environment.name: the source's own rising water
combat_environment.description: The water in the chamber climbs steadily higher as the fight goes on, until standing still anywhere near the center stops being an option.

sunken_root_caverns_the_forgotten_bend.name: The Forgotten Bend
sunken_root_caverns_the_forgotten_bend.description: A small bend off the quiet pool, easy to walk past without noticing -- someone clearly did notice, once.

forgotten_bend_marks.name: a small, worn resting spot
forgotten_bend_marks.description: Whoever cut the smuggling route further in rested here first, before it was ever a route at all.

stonearch_bridge_the_undertows_reach.name: The Undertow's Reach
stonearch_bridge_the_undertows_reach.description: The pull keeps going east past the undertow's own den, further than anything swept downstream should reach.

stonearch_bridge_the_silent_current.name: The Silent Current
stonearch_bridge_the_silent_current.description: The water here moves without a sound at all, which is somehow worse than the noise everywhere else in the gorge.

lockables.name: a cache resting in the silent current

stonearch_bridge_the_gorge_throat.name: The Gorge Throat
stonearch_bridge_the_gorge_throat.description: The gorge narrows to almost nothing here -- a real chokepoint, clearly used as one.

stonearch_bridge_the_hanging_web.name: The Hanging Web
stonearch_bridge_the_hanging_web.description: Silk strung wall to wall here, thick enough to walk on if you're careful -- the one genuinely still room this deep in the gorge.

stonearch_bridge_the_deep_nest.name: The Deep Nest
stonearch_bridge_the_deep_nest.description: A real nest, ancient, layered thick enough that whatever built it has clearly been here a very long time.

resource_nodes.name: a growth of rare cave herbs

deep_nest_record.name: an old marker driven into the nest's own wall
deep_nest_record.description: Someone's been mapping this gorge for longer than the bridge above has had real fortifications -- the marks match the same hand found at the goblin warrens' ledger.

stonearch_bridge_the_watchers_perch.name: The Watcher's Perch
stonearch_bridge_the_watchers_perch.description: A real perch, high enough in the gorge wall to see every approach at once -- whoever built it wanted to watch, not be watched.

stonearch_bridge_the_lower_span.name: The Lower Span
stonearch_bridge_the_lower_span.description: A real, lower span of the gorge, well below the bridge itself -- something old has clearly claimed it.

stonearch_bridge_the_far_approach.name: The Far Approach
stonearch_bridge_the_far_approach.description: The gorge finally starts to open up here -- whatever's using this whole stretch as a route is close now.

far_approach_toll_marks.name: the same toll-token marks found strung at the goblin warrens
far_approach_toll_marks.description: This far from any road, and the same cheap tokens still turn up -- whoever's running this whole operation uses the gorge as a real route, not just a shortcut.

stonearch_bridge_the_scouts_ledge.name: The Scout's Ledge
stonearch_bridge_the_scouts_ledge.description: A real ledge, recently used -- footprints in the dust, still fresh, leading further east.
