stonearch_bridge_the_scouting_ground.name: The Scouting Ground
stonearch_bridge_the_scouting_ground.description: The gorge finally opens onto real, level ground here -- and someone's clearly been using it to watch the whole crossing from a real distance.

stonearch_bridge_the_broken_watch.name: The Broken Watch
stonearch_bridge_the_broken_watch.description: A collapsed watch post, real stonework, fallen long before anyone currently using this gorge was born.

lockables.name: a cache buried in the broken watch post

stonearch_bridge_the_silent_shrine.name: The Silent Shrine
stonearch_bridge_the_silent_shrine.description: A small real shrine, tucked below the hanging web, kept clear of silk by someone who still visits.

silent_shrine_stone.name: a small, clean shrine stone
silent_shrine_stone.description: Someone keeps the silk off this one spot, on purpose, the same way the deeper caverns' own shrine was kept.

stonearch_bridge_the_far_markers.name: The Far Markers
stonearch_bridge_the_far_markers.description: A small cluster of real trail markers, recently placed -- whoever is using this route wants to find their own way back.

far_markers_trail.name: real, recent trail markers
far_markers_trail.description: Placed with real care, recently -- someone comes through here often enough to need them.

stonearch_bridge_the_scouts_camp.name: The Scout's Camp
stonearch_bridge_the_scouts_camp.description: A real, recently-used camp -- cold ashes, a bedroll, nothing left behind by accident.

scouts_camp_ashes.name: a real, recently cold firepit
scouts_camp_ashes.description: Whoever was here left in a hurry, but not in a panic -- packed up properly, just fast.

greymoor_downs_the_sunken_stair.name: The Sunken Stair
greymoor_downs_the_sunken_stair.description: Real steps below the tower cellar, sinking further than the tower's own foundation should reach.

greymoor_downs_the_cellar_hollow.name: The Cellar Hollow
greymoor_downs_the_cellar_hollow.description: A real hollow beneath the cellar, cold enough that the wolves above never bother coming down.

greymoor_downs_the_sealed_larder.name: The Sealed Larder
greymoor_downs_the_sealed_larder.description: A real larder, sealed shut, stocked for a garrison that never came back to eat any of it.

lockables.name: the sealed larder's own real stock

greymoor_downs_the_deeper_dark.name: The Deeper Dark
greymoor_downs_the_deeper_dark.description: Real dark, past anything the tower above was ever meant to reach -- the one genuinely still room this deep down.

greymoor_downs_the_bone_stair.name: The Bone Stair
greymoor_downs_the_bone_stair.description: Real bone, worked into the walls as reinforcement -- whoever built this had more bodies than stone to spare.

resource_nodes.name: a real ore vein exposed in the bone-reinforced wall

greymoor_downs_the_watchers_grave.name: The Watcher's Grave
greymoor_downs_the_watchers_grave.description: A real grave, marked, deliberate -- whoever's buried here was meant to keep watching even after they stopped being able to.

watchers_grave_marker.name: a real, deliberate grave marker
watchers_grave_marker.description: Whoever's buried here was placed facing the way out, on purpose -- still watching, even now.

greymoor_downs_the_marker_hall.name: The Marker Hall
greymoor_downs_the_marker_hall.description: A real hall, lined with the same worn boundary markers found up on the Downs -- someone's been keeping this exact line for a very long time.

greymoor_downs_the_cellar_warden.name: The Cellar Warden's Hall
greymoor_downs_the_cellar_warden.description: A real hall, kept exactly as it was left -- and something's still keeping it that way.

greymoor_downs_the_last_cellar.name: The Last Cellar
greymoor_downs_the_last_cellar.description: The real bottom of the tower's foundation -- older than the tower itself, and clearly still occupied.

last_cellar_record.name: a real, worn record left in the last cellar
last_cellar_record.description: Whoever kept this watch left one final note, unsigned: "the downs remember longer than anyone standing on them does."

greymoor_downs_the_final_approach.name: The Final Approach
greymoor_downs_the_final_approach.description: The last real stretch before whatever's actually still keeping this whole watch -- quiet, cold, and clearly not alone.

greymoor_downs_the_downs_last_watch.name: The Downs' Last Watch
greymoor_downs_the_downs_last_watch.description: The real, final watch beneath the Downs -- and whatever's kept it this whole time has been waiting a very long time to be relieved.

combat_environment.name: the last watch's own real, settling foundation stones
combat_environment.description: Real stone, real age, real weight -- fighting hard enough down here risks bringing a genuine piece of the tower's own foundation down.

greymoor_downs_the_stairs_landing.name: The Stair's Landing
greymoor_downs_the_stairs_landing.description: A small landing partway down the sunken stair, real and deliberate, clearly meant as a resting point.

greymoor_downs_the_hollows_edge.name: The Hollow's Edge
greymoor_downs_the_hollows_edge.description: The real edge of the cellar hollow, easy to overlook -- something small has been left here, on purpose.

hollows_edge_marker.name: a small, real marker left at the edge
hollows_edge_marker.description: Someone left this here deliberately, a real waypoint for whoever came looking after them.

greymoor_downs_the_bone_niche.name: The Bone Niche
greymoor_downs_the_bone_niche.description: A small niche off the bone stair, real and deliberate, sealed shut once and not since.

lockables.name: a real cache sealed into the bone niche

greymoor_downs_the_markers_answer.name: The Marker's Answer
greymoor_downs_the_markers_answer.description: A small side chamber where the boundary markers finally explain themselves, to whoever actually asks.

greymoor_downs_the_cellars_own_ledger.name: The Cellar's Own Ledger
greymoor_downs_the_cellars_own_ledger.description: A small side room, real ledgers stacked floor to ceiling -- whoever kept this watch was thorough about it.

cellars_ledger.name: a real, thorough ledger
cellars_ledger.description: Every shift, every watch, recorded for generations -- right up until the entries just stop, mid-page.

wrathflame_vault_sealed_reliquary.name: The Sealed Reliquary
wrathflame_vault_sealed_reliquary.description: A small stone alcove behind the gallery wall, untouched since whatever sealed it shut. The air here is still, unlike everywhere else in the vault.

reliquary_ledger.name: a fire-warped ledger
reliquary_ledger.description: Names, dates, and a final entry that just reads: 'It listens now. It didn't used to.' Whoever wrote it never came back to finish the page.

wrathflame_vault_cinder_key_alcove.name: The Cinder Key Alcove
wrathflame_vault_cinder_key_alcove.description: A dead-end chamber past the font, where something molten stands guard -- whatever it is guarding will only ever be yours once it is finally put down.

wrathflame_vault_forgeholds_cache.name: The Forgehold's Cache
wrathflame_vault_forgeholds_cache.description: A cramped storeroom the old forge-wardens kept locked, apparently out of habit more than need.

deep_root_vault_root_bound_alcove.name: The Root-Bound Alcove
deep_root_vault_root_bound_alcove.description: A hollow behind the bramble wall, root-tangled floor to ceiling, that something has clearly been keeping deliberately closed off.

alcove_root_carving.name: a carving worked into living root
alcove_root_carving.description: Whoever made this fed it into the root itself, growing the message rather than cutting it: 'It sleeps. It always wakes. Don't wake it twice.'

deep_root_vault_last_seed.name: The Last Seed
deep_root_vault_last_seed.description: A dead-end root chamber, curled protectively around a single seed that's never actually sprouted -- it will only let go once whatever is guarding it is finally put down.

deep_root_vault_husks_last_cache.name: The Husk's Last Cache
deep_root_vault_husks_last_cache.description: Whatever the elder husk was guarding this chamber for, it stashed its own supplies here first.

sunken_root_caverns_the_silt_hollow.name: The Silt Hollow
sunken_root_caverns_the_silt_hollow.description: A shallow pocket half-filled with fine grey silt, something real and deliberately shaped buried in it -- it will only ever be yours once whatever is guarding it is finally put down.

sunken_root_caverns_the_silt_vault.name: The Silt Vault
sunken_root_caverns_the_silt_vault.description: Whatever the old warren-runners were hiding from each other, they hid it here -- dry, undisturbed, and very deliberately sealed.

silt_vault_marker.name: a marker scratched into the vault wall
silt_vault_marker.description: Whoever sealed this counted on nobody else ever having the key -- the scratch marks trail off mid-sentence, like they never finished the thought before something changed their mind.

sunken_root_caverns_the_choked_reliquary.name: The Choked Reliquary
sunken_root_caverns_the_choked_reliquary.description: A small side-chamber behind the rubble, kept just clear enough by someone -- or something -- that clearly still cares what's in here.

reliquary_root_tablet.name: a tablet grown out of living root
reliquary_root_tablet.description: Fed into the root the same way the deep vaults do it, letter by letter: 'The water remembers everyone who ever tried to leave it dry.'

goblin_warrens_the_deep_vein.name: The Deep Vein
goblin_warrens_the_deep_vein.description: A real, worked vein cutting through the rock, far too clean to be goblin work -- and something has made a den of guarding whatever's left of it.

goblin_warrens_the_deep_stash.name: The Deep Stash
goblin_warrens_the_deep_stash.description: Whatever the warren's own diggers found down here, they kept it behind real iron, not just rubble.

deep_stash_marker.name: a marker scratched into the stash wall
deep_stash_marker.description: Whoever sealed this counted on nobody else ever having the key -- and, judging by the dust, nobody ever did until now.

greymoor_downs_the_wardens_hollow.name: The Warden's Hollow
greymoor_downs_the_wardens_hollow.description: A real, deliberately dug side-chamber, kept just clear enough that something has clearly still been using it.

greymoor_downs_the_wardens_vault.name: The Warden's Vault
greymoor_downs_the_wardens_vault.description: Real, deliberate storage -- whatever the downs' own watch kept sealed away, they meant to keep it that way.

wardens_vault_marker.name: a marker scratched into the vault wall
wardens_vault_marker.description: Whoever sealed this counted on nobody else ever having the key -- and, judging by the dust, nobody ever did until now.

the_first_city_the_watchers_secret.name: The Watcher's Secret
the_first_city_the_watchers_secret.description: A real hollow behind the glyph wall, kept just clear enough that whatever answered the Watching Glyph clearly still comes back to it.

watchers_secret_tablet.name: a tablet carved with the same unfamiliar glyphs as the spire above
watchers_secret_tablet.description: The same counting-script from the city's own entrance, worn smooth here from something tracing it, over and over, for longer than anyone's been alive to see it.

the_first_city_the_old_archive.name: The Old Archive
the_first_city_the_old_archive.description: A real, sealed record-room off the city's own entrance, holding a single deliberately-kept key -- and something has made a den of guarding it.

the_first_city_the_old_vault.name: The Old Vault
the_first_city_the_old_vault.description: Real, deliberate storage built into the city's own foundations -- whoever sealed it meant for it to stay that way.

old_vault_marker.name: a marker carved into the vault's own stone
old_vault_marker.description: Whoever sealed this counted on nobody else ever having the key -- and, judging by the dust, nobody ever did until now.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_entrance.name: The Cracked Seal
wrathflame_vault_evolved_entrance.description: Where the old vault wall finally gave, and heat that was never natural pours up through the new gap.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_hub.name: The Ember Confluence
wrathflame_vault_evolved_hub.description: Seven raw tunnels meet here, each radiating its own kind of wrongness -- heat from somewhere below rises through all of them at once.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r0.name: The Choir Landing
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r0.description: A stair landing gone quiet, the way a throat goes quiet right before it screams.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r1.name: The Silent Choir's Hall
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r1.description: Something here used to sing in unison. It still moves in unison -- it just doesn't have any sound left.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r2.name: The Loom Passage
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r2.description: Threads of something not quite fabric span wall to wall, and whatever wove them is still tending the pattern.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r3.name: The Farthest Warren Vent
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b1_r3.description: A tunnel bored in from somewhere else entirely, warmer at this end than it has any right to be.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b2_r0.name: The Stilled Works
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b2_r0.description: Machinery that should have rusted solid centuries ago instead stands ready, waiting on a command no one alive gave it.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b2_r1.name: The Scout's Perch
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b2_r1.description: A lookout post someone built facing entirely the wrong direction, watching for a threat that already got past it.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b3_r0.name: The Toll Landing
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b3_r0.description: A collection point for a toll no one living remembers agreeing to pay.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b3_r1.name: The Bone Cairn Approach
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b3_r1.description: Old remains stacked with real care, a long time ago, by someone who is very much still keeping watch over them.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b3_r2.name: The Crystalline Seam
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b3_r2.description: Veins of raw crystal run through the rock here, and something small and many-legged has made a home in every one of them.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b4_r0.name: The Turning Stair
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b4_r0.description: A stairwell that spirals in a direction stairs shouldn't, guarded by something that clearly knows the difference.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b4_r1.name: The Buried Cache
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b4_r1.description: A half-collapsed side-chamber -- a real cache still wedged into the rubble, and, further back, an old lever that looks like it leads somewhere useful.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b5_r0.name: The Bound Loom
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b5_r0.description: Another loom, this one shackled -- whoever built these clearly stopped trusting them at some point.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b5_r1.name: The Second Loom Hall
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b5_r1.description: Identical to the last loom hall in every way except the pattern it's weaving.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b5_r2.name: The Channel Cistern
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b5_r2.description: Runoff channels converge here, carrying heat, ash, and at least one very confused goblin down from somewhere above.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b6_r0.name: The Elder Seam
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b6_r0.description: The crystal here has grown large enough to have its own permanent tenant.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b6_r1.name: The Watching Cairn
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b6_r1.description: A smaller cairn than the one above, tended just as carefully.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r0.name: The Vault Behind the Vault
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r0.description: Past the sealed door, the air changes -- this was never part of the original vault at all.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r1.name: The Lurker's Approach
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r1.description: Something further in has been listening to every step since the door opened.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r2.name: The Last Stretch
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r2.description: The tunnel narrows here, on purpose, so that whatever's ahead only ever has to face one of you at a time.

wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r3.name: The Glyph's Own Chamber
wrathflame_vault_evolved_b7_r3.description: Carved floor to ceiling in a script no living scholar has ever translated -- and something is still actively adding to it.

the_unmoored_isle.name: The Unmoored Isle
the_unmoored_isle.description: An island of grey stone drifting slowly above the clouds, tethered to nothing anyone can see. Something on it has been waiting a very long time.

waiting_shape.name: a still shape at the island's center
waiting_shape.description: Motionless, silhouetted, and unmistakably waiting — for how long, and for what, you can't yet say.

isles_edge.name: the island's crumbling edge
isles_edge.description: Looking over it, the clouds below part just long enough to show how very far down the world actually is.

combat_environment.name: the crumbling edge of the isle itself
combat_environment.description: Grey stone that was never meant to hold this much weight, tethered to nothing -- kicking loose a real piece of it is a real risk to everyone standing near the edge.

unmoored_isle_hollow.name: The Hollow Beneath the Wait
unmoored_isle_hollow.description: Where the waiting shape stood is now just a hollow in the stone — and the hollow, it turns out, goes down, not into the isle's rock but into something the isle was only ever resting on top of.

the_hollow_itself.name: the hollow left behind
the_hollow_itself.description: Not empty so much as finally uncovered — whatever the waiting shape spent all that time standing on top of.

unmoored_isle_turning_stair.name: The Turning Stair
unmoored_isle_turning_stair.description: A stair that turns back on itself in ways the eye refuses to follow — climbing it and descending it are, as far as anyone can tell, the exact same motion.

impossible_steps.name: the stair's impossible steps
impossible_steps.description: Every step looks identical to the one before it. Somewhere behind you, without ever turning around, you're fairly sure you've started climbing the same stair a second time.

unmoored_isle_loom.name: The Loom
unmoored_isle_loom.description: Threads run wall to wall in patterns too vast to see whole from any one place in the room — and every pattern, followed far enough, leads back to where it started.

the_running_threads.name: the loom's running threads
the_running_threads.description: "I end where I began, and begin again where I ended. What am I?" -- woven directly into the pattern itself, in threads that don't quite match the color of everything around them.

unmoored_isle_first_wait.name: The First Wait
unmoored_isle_first_wait.description: Before there was a shape to wait, something was already waiting here — and it has been patient for far longer than the story anyone's been told about this place.

before_the_beginning.name: whatever was here before the beginning
before_the_beginning.description: It was never the waiting shape's island. The waiting shape was just the latest thing it wore to keep watching.

combat_environment.name: the ground that was never meant to hold anything
combat_environment.description: Something was waiting here before there was a shape to wait -- the ground itself remembers that, and it's not stable.

unmoored_isle_afterimage.name: The Afterimage
unmoored_isle_afterimage.description: A space that only exists because something else already passed through it — an impression left in the air itself, still holding the shape of whatever cast it.

the_lingering_impression.name: the lingering impression in the air
the_lingering_impression.description: Whatever left this behind is long gone. The shape it left isn't done watching, though.

unmoored_isle_last_measure.name: The Last Measure
unmoored_isle_last_measure.description: The Loom's pattern finally runs out here, frayed at the edge into threads that don't lead anywhere else — the very last measure of something that was never going to resolve cleanly.

the_frayed_edge.name: the pattern's frayed edge
the_frayed_edge.description: Every thread in the loom eventually reaches this exact point and simply stops -- not cut, not finished, just done.

unmoored_isle_missed_step.name: The Missed Step
unmoored_isle_missed_step.description: A step on the turning stair that doesn't quite connect to any of the others — easy to fall into by accident, and just as easy to never notice was ever there at all.

the_disconnected_step.name: the disconnected step itself
the_disconnected_step.description: It doesn't lead anywhere the rest of the stair goes. That was apparently the entire point of building it.

unmoored_isle_drifting_threshold.name: The Drifting Threshold
unmoored_isle_drifting_threshold.description: The isle's stone keeps going here, well past where it should have run out into open air.

unmoored_isle_the_backward_hall.name: The Backward Hall
unmoored_isle_the_backward_hall.description: Every real sound in this hall arrives before whatever made it actually happens.

unmoored_isle_the_repeating_door.name: The Repeating Door
unmoored_isle_the_repeating_door.description: A single door, opened and closed the same number of times by everyone who's ever reached it.

lockables.name: a cache behind the repeating door

unmoored_isle_the_upside_stair.name: The Upside Stair
unmoored_isle_the_upside_stair.description: A stair that climbs in a direction that only makes sense if you don't look directly at your own feet.

unmoored_isle_the_floating_garden.name: The Floating Garden
unmoored_isle_the_floating_garden.description: Real, growing things, somehow, this high up -- the one genuinely calm room on the whole isle.

floating_garden_bloom.name: a real, blooming garden
floating_garden_bloom.description: Nothing about this should still be alive up here. It clearly doesn't care.

unmoored_isle_the_untethered_bridge.name: The Untethered Bridge
unmoored_isle_the_untethered_bridge.description: A bridge with nothing holding either end down, somehow perfectly still.

resource_nodes.name: a vein of oddly weightless ore

unmoored_isle_the_folded_atrium.name: The Folded Atrium
unmoored_isle_the_folded_atrium.description: A room that is somehow also, at the same time, the hallway leading into it.

unmoored_isle_the_drifting_halls_end.name: Where the Drifting Halls End
unmoored_isle_the_drifting_halls_end.description: The halls simply stop here, all at once, like whoever built them ran out of reason to keep going.

unmoored_isle_the_mirrored_threshold.name: The Mirrored Threshold
unmoored_isle_the_mirrored_threshold.description: The stone underfoot reflects the sky above it so cleanly it's genuinely hard to tell which way is down.

unmoored_isle_the_upside_down_lake.name: The Upside-Down Lake
unmoored_isle_the_upside_down_lake.description: A real lake, held in place above the isle rather than on it, water pooling toward the sky instead of away from it.

lake_wrong_reflection.name: the lake's own reflection
lake_wrong_reflection.description: It shows the isle as it must have looked before it was ever an island -- whole, and attached to something much larger.

unmoored_isle_the_second_shadow.name: The Second Shadow
unmoored_isle_the_second_shadow.description: A shadow here that doesn't belong to anything currently standing in the room.

lockables.name: a cache tucked into the shadow itself

unmoored_isle_the_reflected_stair.name: The Reflected Stair
unmoored_isle_the_reflected_stair.description: A stair down that is, impossibly, also a stair up, depending entirely on which direction you started from.

unmoored_isle_the_glass_garden.name: The Glass Garden
unmoored_isle_the_glass_garden.description: Every real plant here has been replaced, leaf for leaf, by something that only looks like glass until you touch it.

unmoored_isle_the_argument_of_echoes.name: The Argument of Echoes
unmoored_isle_the_argument_of_echoes.description: Two voices, arguing, neither of them willing to admit which one is the real one.

unmoored_isle_the_reflection_deepens.name: Where the Reflection Deepens
unmoored_isle_the_reflection_deepens.description: The one genuinely still room on this whole side of the isle -- everything here is calm, deliberately.

deepening_reflection_note.name: a record scratched into the stillest water
deepening_reflection_note.description: Whatever's down at the true bottom of this reflection has been waiting for someone to actually look.

unmoored_isle_the_sunken_reflections_end.name: The Sunken Reflection's End
unmoored_isle_the_sunken_reflections_end.description: The reflection finally shows something real -- and it's already looking back.

combat_environment.name: the reflection's own bottomless water
combat_environment.description: The deeper this fight goes, the less the water here looks like it's reflecting the room at all.

unmoored_isle_the_radiant_stair.name: The Radiant Stair
unmoored_isle_the_radiant_stair.description: A stair climbing toward real, warm light -- the first genuinely warm thing anyone's found on this whole cold island.

unmoored_isle_the_sunward_ledge.name: The Sunward Ledge
unmoored_isle_the_sunward_ledge.description: A ledge facing a sunrise that never actually arrives, though the light keeps promising it will.

unmoored_isle_the_warming_hollow.name: The Warming Hollow
unmoored_isle_the_warming_hollow.description: Real warmth pools here, safe and steady -- the calmest spot on the whole radiant side of the isle.

resource_nodes.name: a bed of sun-warmed herbs

unmoored_isle_the_climbing_light.name: The Climbing Light
unmoored_isle_the_climbing_light.description: The light here climbs the walls instead of falling from above, always reaching a little higher than it did a moment ago.

climbing_light_record.name: a record etched into the climbing light's own path
climbing_light_record.description: Whatever this light has been reaching toward for so long is close now -- close enough that the reaching itself has started to feel deliberate.

unmoored_isle_the_high_approach.name: The High Approach
unmoored_isle_the_high_approach.description: The path narrows here, deliberately, like whatever's ahead wants to see exactly who's still coming.

unmoored_isle_the_suns_threshold.name: The Sun's Threshold
unmoored_isle_the_suns_threshold.description: The very edge of the radiant approach, warm enough now to be uncomfortable -- whatever's past here is the real source of it.

lockables.name: a sun-warmed cache set into the threshold

unmoored_isle_the_spires_grace_sanctum.name: The Spire's Grace Sanctum
unmoored_isle_the_spires_grace_sanctum.description: The First City's tallest spire was built facing the sunrise -- and somehow, impossibly, the real thing it was always reaching for turned out to be up here.

unmoored_isle_the_drifting_hollow.name: The Drifting Hollow
unmoored_isle_the_drifting_hollow.description: A real, motionless pocket of air just off the isle's own edge, holding still against every current -- and something has made a den of guarding whatever's caught in it.

unmoored_isle_the_drifting_vault.name: The Drifting Vault
unmoored_isle_the_drifting_vault.description: A real, sealed pocket of the isle's own substance, holding together out here through nothing anyone can explain.

drifting_vault_marker.name: a marker scratched into the vault's own substance
drifting_vault_marker.description: Whoever sealed this counted on nobody else ever having the key -- and, judging by how untouched it is, nobody ever did until now.

grimsby.name: Grimsby
grimsby.personality: a gruff but kind-hearted innkeeper who's outlived three generations of regulars and buried more adventurers than he'll admit to
grimsby.goals: wants someone reliable to look into the strange things he won't say out loud

old_maren.name: Old Maren
old_maren.personality: a sharp-tongued trader who has an answer for everything except why she never leaves Market Row after dark

sera_wanderer.name: Sarah
sera_wanderer.personality: a quiet, capable ranger passing through, sizing up anyone who might be worth traveling with
sera_wanderer.goals: looking for a group heading somewhere interesting
activity_goals: scouting the treeline for whatever's been unsettling Grimsby
trading road stories with whoever's willing to listen
helping Old Maren haul in a delivery
sizing up the bridge crossing for safer routes

theron_the_wanderer.name: Theron
theron_the_wanderer.personality: a quiet, unaligned drifter who speaks in riddles and owes loyalty to no one — not unfriendly, but never quite trustworthy either
activity_goals: sitting with the well's warmth, listening for something under it
trading a riddle for a rumor with anyone passing through
walking the tree line without any obvious destination
watching the goblin warrens from a safe distance

kess_the_bandit.name: Kess
kess_the_bandit.personality: a cold, calculating highwaywoman who sizes up travelers as marks before they've even noticed her — cruel by choice, not desperation
kess_the_bandit.goals: collecting tolls to fund something far bigger than banditry — she'd never say what, and the coin never stays with her crew

kess_the_unbound.name: Kess, the Unbound
kess_the_unbound.personality: what's left of Kess after the crown of coin and threat finally broke -- the calculation is gone, and something underneath is doing the deciding now, in a voice that isn't quite hers
kess_the_unbound.goals: no longer tolls, no longer coin -- it wants what's left of the party standing between it and whatever it was promised

ossian_vane.name: Ossian Vane
ossian_vane.personality: a charming, unhurried trader who never quite answers where his stock comes from, and seems to find that question more amusing each time it's asked

borin_ironjaw.name: Borin Ironjaw
borin_ironjaw.personality: a stern, no-nonsense dwarf doing penance for an old failure by watching over the market instead of a castle gate
borin_ironjaw.goals: looking for someone worth vouching for, so he can finally stop watching this street

wren_hollowbrook.name: Wren Hollowbrook
wren_hollowbrook.personality: a quiet half-elf hermit who has tended this shrine's wild garden longer than anyone in town can remember, and speaks more easily to the plants than to people
wren_hollowbrook.goals: protecting the shrine from anyone who'd disturb it without understanding it first

pip_thistledown.name: Pip Thistledown
pip_thistledown.personality: a cheerful halfling bard who's been 'just about to cross' this bridge for three days now, always with one more story first
pip_thistledown.goals: collecting a good enough story to finally justify moving on

grask_emberscale.name: Grask Emberscale
grask_emberscale.personality: a dragonborn barbarian the goblins captured but never quite managed to break, still watching the tunnel entrance for a chance worth taking
grask_emberscale.goals: getting out of these warrens and putting them a long way behind him

vesh_nightglass.name: Vesh Nightglass
vesh_nightglass.personality: a tiefling sorcerer who got turned around chasing a light down here and has been living off crystal-glow for longer than she'll admit
vesh_nightglass.goals: finding someone who actually knows the way back to the surface

mira_the_cartographer.name: Mira
mira_the_cartographer.personality: sharp, competitive, and openly annoyed that someone else found their way down here first
mira_the_cartographer.goals: mapping the First City before anyone else can claim to have done it properly

the_watching_glyph.name: The Watching Glyph
the_watching_glyph.personality: ancient, patient, and utterly indifferent to whether anyone ever answers it correctly
the_watching_glyph.goals: has been asking the same question of everyone who reaches it, for longer than anyone alive

the_folded_voice.name: The Folded Voice
the_folded_voice.personality: speaks every sentence as though it's already been said before, and will be again
the_folded_voice.goals: has been asking the same thing of everyone who reaches the atrium, in every direction at once

the_argument.name: The Argument
the_argument.personality: speaks only in disagreement with itself, each half finishing the other's sentence differently
the_argument.goals: has never once agreed with its own echo, and won't let anyone past until they do

the_silent_bookkeeper.name: The Silent Bookkeeper
the_silent_bookkeeper.personality: keeps a perfect, obsessive count of everything that passes, and refuses to let anyone by until their own count is settled
the_silent_bookkeeper.goals: has been balancing the same ledger for longer than the warren has existed

the_tangled_warden.name: The Tangled Warden
the_tangled_warden.personality: grown from root instead of born, speaks slowly, and has never once been in a hurry to let anyone through
the_tangled_warden.goals: has been asking the same thing of the caverns for longer than they've had a name

the_wellsprings_keeper.name: The Wellspring's Keeper
the_wellsprings_keeper.personality: speaks in the rhythm of dripping water, never in a hurry, never repeating itself the same way twice
the_wellsprings_keeper.goals: has been testing everyone who reaches the deepest pool with the same real question

the_gate_carving.name: The Gate Carving
the_gate_carving.personality: speaks in the same worn, half-legible cadence as the bridge's own rail carvings
the_gate_carving.goals: has been guarding the carved gate since before the bridge had a name worth remembering

the_watchers_perch_voice.name: The Watcher's Perch
the_watchers_perch_voice.personality: watches everything that crosses the gorge below and has never once looked away first
the_watchers_perch_voice.goals: has been keeping the same real count of everyone who's ever tried to cross unseen

kess_scouting.name: Kess
kess_scouting.personality: the same calm, calculating woman from the crossroads toll, clearly enjoying herself now that she has real room to move
kess_scouting.goals: testing whoever's been closing in on her operation, and seeing exactly what they're carrying while she does it

the_downs_own_marker.name: The Downs' Own Marker
the_downs_own_marker.personality: worn nearly smooth by wind and years, and still, somehow, legible to whoever actually needs it to be
the_downs_own_marker.goals: has been marking the same real boundary since long before the watchtower ever needed one

the_ash_bound_warden.name: The Ash-Bound Warden
the_ash_bound_warden.personality: speaks only in riddles, and has clearly been doing so for far longer than is healthy
the_ash_bound_warden.goals: won't let anyone near the reliquary until they've proven they understand what the vault actually is

the_bramble_bound_voice.name: The Bramble-Bound Voice
the_bramble_bound_voice.personality: speaks slowly, like every word costs it something, and won't be rushed into repeating itself
the_bramble_bound_voice.goals: guards the alcove the way it's always guarded it -- by making sure whoever enters actually understands what they're walking past

the_choked_reliquarys_voice.name: The Choked Reliquary's Voice
the_choked_reliquarys_voice.personality: dry, patient, and entirely uninterested in repeating itself for anyone who wasn't listening the first time
the_choked_reliquarys_voice.goals: keeps the reliquary closed to anyone who hasn't proven they understand what the caverns actually are

marens_wares.description: Old Maren's stall sprawls across three tables — a weapon rack, a rack of hung armor, and shelves of tools and provisions, every price scratched straight into the wood in her own tally-marks.

vanes_curiosities.description: Ossian Vane's corner of the Arcane Nook — scrolls pinned in neat rows, a locked case of stranger things, and a ledger he never quite lets anyone read.

grimsbys_tavern.description: Grimsby keeps a short shelf behind the bar — ale, rations, and just enough healing to get a rough night behind you.

welcome_to_the_crossroads.title: A Favor for Grimsby
welcome_to_the_crossroads.description: Grimsby has noticed something's off in the Whispering Wood and wants eyes on it.
welcome_to_the_crossroads.clue: Grimsby says the wrongness he's felt seems to trail off toward the treeline west of the tavern.

seras_safer_crossing.title: Sarah's Safer Crossing
seras_safer_crossing.description: Sarah's been sizing up the Stonearch Bridge crossing, uneasy about who else might be using it to move unseen -- she'd rather have a second set of eyes before trusting the route.
seras_safer_crossing.clue: Sarah says she'll feel better about the bridge once someone's actually walked it with her -- whoever's been crossing at night always seems to be heading toward the Downs.

seras_resolution.title: Worth Traveling With
seras_resolution.description: Sarah's spent long enough sizing up this party to have an answer now, one way or another -- she wants to give it to you back at the bridge crossing where she first asked for a second set of eyes.
seras_resolution.clue: Sarah keeps glancing down the far road out of town, like she's still weighing whether to take it.

borins_vouching_task.title: A Name Worth Vouching For
borins_vouching_task.description: Borin's done penance on this street long enough to know he can't vouch for anyone he hasn't actually seen handle real danger -- he wants the party to deal with whatever's really going on in the Goblin Warrens before he'll put his name behind them.
borins_vouching_task.clue: Borin says a name means nothing until it's been tested somewhere that actually matters.

borins_resolution.title: The Watch He Keeps
borins_resolution.description: Borin's tested the party in the Warrens like he said he would -- now it's just a matter of whether he actually believes his own penance is paid, standing right back where he's stood watch this whole time.
borins_resolution.clue: Borin still takes up the same spot on Market Row every morning, like he hasn't decided anything yet.

borins_blackthorn_warning.title: More Than Banditry
borins_blackthorn_warning.description: Borin's watched the roads long enough to know real banditry when he sees it, and the Blackthorn Raiders working the Greymoor Downs aren't it -- too well-fed, too well-armed, and the coin they take never seems to stay with them. He wants the party to see the Downs for themselves and judge who's really paying for it.
borins_blackthorn_warning.clue: Borin says a captain who takes tolls but never keeps the coin is working for somebody, not just herself.

kess_first_reckoning.title: The Name on the Page
kess_first_reckoning.description: The ledger page names no one Borin recognizes, but it's real proof the one calling herself Kess answers to someone else entirely. He wants her stopped and questioned before whatever she's funding gets any further along.
kess_first_reckoning.clue: Borin: 'Whoever's holding her leash won't show themselves while she's still standing.'

kess_the_unbound_reckoning.title: What Answered Instead
kess_the_unbound_reckoning.description: Kess went down and stayed down -- and then she didn't. Something got up wearing her face, taller than her, wrong in the joints, already forgetting to sound like her. Borin says whatever they questioned a moment ago is gone; what's left has to be finished, now, before it remembers how to run.
kess_the_unbound_reckoning.clue: Borin, quieter than you've ever heard him: 'That was never just a bandit captain. Go. Finish it.'

wrens_root_worry.title: What the Roots Are Hiding
wrens_root_worry.description: Wren's shrine draws on something growing down in the Sunken Root Caverns, and lately it's felt wrong -- she wants someone who isn't afraid of the dark to go see what's changed down there.
wrens_root_worry.clue: Wren says the shrine's garden has been restless the same way it was the last time something changed down below -- and that whatever's disturbing it smells faintly of coin, of all things.

wrens_resolution.title: Roots Worth Trusting
wrens_resolution.description: Wren's let the party into the Sunken Root Caverns once already -- now it's a matter of whether she'll actually tell them what the shrine's roots are drawing on, back where she's kept that secret all along.
wrens_resolution.clue: Wren keeps almost saying something about the shrine's roots, then talking to the garden instead.

pips_story_worth_telling.title: A Story Worth Telling
pips_story_worth_telling.description: Pip's been stalling on this bridge for three days waiting for one good story before he'll finally move on -- he wants the party to bring back proof of something genuinely worth singing about from the Whispering Wood.
pips_story_worth_telling.clue: Pip says a story only counts if he can honestly say he sent someone to go get it.

pips_resolution.title: The Story He's Already In
pips_resolution.description: Pip got his story out of the Whispering Wood -- now it's just a matter of whether he realizes the better one's been happening around him this whole time, back on the same bridge he's been stalling on for days.
pips_resolution.clue: Pip's still saying he's 'just about to cross,' but he's stopped actually packing to leave.

grasks_freedom.title: Grask's Freedom
grasks_freedom.description: Grask has been watching the tunnel entrance for a chance worth taking ever since the goblins caught him -- the party dealing with what's really running this warren is exactly the chance he's been waiting for.
grasks_freedom.clue: Grask says whoever's giving these goblins their orders is the only thing standing between him and the surface.

grasks_resolution.title: Grask's Choice
grasks_resolution.description: Every step back down has been against everything Grask swore to himself once he got out -- and he's taking every one of them anyway, because the party asked, not because the warrens ever let go of him.
grasks_resolution.clue: Grask keeps saying he's done with tunnels, then keeps following the party into the next one.

veshs_way_back.title: Vesh's Way Back
veshs_way_back.description: Vesh got turned around chasing a light down into Glimmerdeep Grotto and has been living off crystal-glow ever since -- she just wants someone who actually knows the way to walk her back up to The Crossroads Tavern.
veshs_way_back.clue: Vesh says she stopped trying to count the days once the crystal-glow started tasting normal.

veshs_resolution.title: Back Down Into the Glow
veshs_resolution.description: The party needs someone who's actually been past Glimmerdeep Grotto before, and Vesh is the only one who has -- which means going back to exactly the place she spent this long trying to forget.
veshs_resolution.clue: Vesh goes quiet every time the crystal-glow comes up again.

the_hollow_stump.title: The Hollow Stump
the_hollow_stump.description: The shrine in the Whispering Wood may hold answers to what's been left behind there.
the_hollow_stump.clue: Old offerings at the shrine are undisturbed by animals — worth seeing with your own eyes.

clear_the_warrens.title: Clear the Goblin Warrens
clear_the_warrens.description: The goblins under Stonearch Bridge have grown bold. Someone should find out why.
clear_the_warrens.clue: Whatever's emboldened the goblins seems to answer to something bigger among them -- their warrens lie underground, reached by descending into the Weeping Well past Stonearch Bridge.

the_wrong_color.title: The Wrong Color
the_wrong_color.description: Something in Glimmerdeep Grotto is changing the crystals. Investigate.
the_wrong_color.clue: Travelers who've passed the Sunken Root Caverns mention a faint, wrong-colored light deeper in.

the_hush_stage1_signs.title: Into the Hush
the_hush_stage1_signs.description: No two accounts of what's past Glimmerdeep Grotto agree — that alone is worth noting. The only way to know for certain is to go down and see it yourself.
the_hush_stage1_signs.clue: No two accounts of what's past Glimmerdeep Grotto agree — that alone is worth noting.

the_hush_stage2_the_wisp.title: What Watches in the Dark
the_hush_stage2_the_wisp.description: Something pale and quick moves at the edge of every torch's reach down here, blinding anyone who gets too close a good look at it — it has to be dealt with before whatever's deeper even notices you've arrived.
the_hush_stage2_the_wisp.clue: Footprints in old dust, fresh enough that the dust hasn't resettled — something else is already down here.

the_hush_stage3_the_unspoken.title: What Answers Back
the_hush_stage3_the_unspoken.description: Few who go into the Hush Below come back describing the same thing twice — and something down there has started describing YOU back, in a voice that isn't quite a voice.
the_hush_stage3_the_unspoken.clue: An old iron door, ajar, wasn't open a moment ago — whatever moved it wants to be found now. Whatever's past that door, you won't want to face it with anyone you don't genuinely trust at your back.

first_city_arrival.title: Beneath Everything
first_city_arrival.description: The tunnels give way all at once — not to more tunnel, but to towers and streets, a whole skyline swallowed and kept in the dark, far older than anything else you've found down here.
first_city_arrival.clue: Whatever's down here was never meant to be found — but you've already seen it now.

the_first_city_quest.title: The First City
the_first_city_quest.description: Beneath everything, something predates the goblins, the roots, and the crystals — and the spire's slow, warm breathing has just changed rhythm.
the_first_city_quest.clue: Everything so far has felt like the edge of something older, further down.

conflict_at_crossroads_tavern.title: Conflict at Crossroads Tavern
conflict_at_crossroads_tavern.description: Word of what you found beneath the First City won't stay buried for long, and it isn't the only thing stirring. Rising concerns are already being talked about back on the surface — the Crossroads Tavern is where the roads still meet, and the paladin stationed there has never let real trouble past unremarked.
conflict_at_crossroads_tavern.clue: Find the paladin at the Crossroads Tavern and ask about the Rising Concerns.

unmoored_isle_arrival.title: What the Sky Was Hiding
unmoored_isle_arrival.description: The shard grows warm in your hand and pulls upward, past the spire's reach, into empty sky that isn't empty at all.
unmoored_isle_arrival.clue: Follow where the shard wants to go — up, past the spire, into open sky.

the_unmoored_isle_quest.title: What Waits Above
the_unmoored_isle_quest.description: The sky itself is not as empty as it looks — something has been waiting at the island's center for a very long time, and it's noticed you.
the_unmoored_isle_quest.clue: The shard you carry seems to want to go up, not down.

marens_locked_ledger.title: Maren's Locked Ledger
marens_locked_ledger.description: Old Maren has an old strongbox she's lost the combination to, and swears there's a riddle carved into its lid that used to be the answer.
marens_locked_ledger.clue: The riddle carved into the lid reads: "I have cities, but no houses; forests, but no trees; rivers, but no water. What am I?"

the_elder_glens_riddle.title: The Elder Glen's Riddle
the_elder_glens_riddle.description: Words carved into the widest tree in the Elder Glen — old enough that whoever carved them is long gone, but the question still stands.
the_elder_glens_riddle.clue: The words carved into the tree read: "I have many rings but no fingers, many arms but no hands, and I tell your age without ever asking. What am I?"

the_archives_recess.title: The Archive's Recess
the_archives_recess.description: A recess carved into the rear wall of the Sunken Archive, words worn into its edge — whoever carved them wanted this one specifically remembered.
the_archives_recess.clue: The words carved at the recess's edge read: "I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?"

the_weeping_wells_secret.title: The Weeping Well's Secret
the_weeping_wells_secret.description: Sarah thinks the well's strange warmth isn't natural, and that whatever's behind it is worth finding, not just noting.
the_weeping_wells_secret.clue: Sarah says the sealed door low in the well's wall is the only part of it that isn't carved from ordinary stone.

the_unrepeating_depth.title: What Finally Speaks
the_unrepeating_depth.description: Past the seam in the Deepest Record's floor, the walls stop repeating themselves entirely — and whatever kept them company down here is done waiting to be read.
the_unrepeating_depth.clue: Nothing about this place was ever part of the story everyone else was told.

verge_wraiths_unrest.title: The Wraith's Unrest
verge_wraiths_unrest.description: Whatever haunts the Hollow Verge's threshold isn't going to let anyone deeper in while it's still standing.
verge_wraiths_unrest.clue: The wraith seems less interested in stopping you than in making sure you remember it was here first.

bonefields_march.title: The March That Never Ended
bonefields_march.description: The Bonefield's ranks won't break formation on their own -- someone has to actually give them a reason to stop standing at attention.
bonefields_march.clue: A few of the nearer ranks have started turning their heads toward the cairn, like they're waiting for the same order you are.

cairns_silence.title: The Cairn's Silence
cairns_silence.description: The Sealed Cairn's door has no hinge and no lock -- just a riddle worn nearly smooth, and it isn't opening for anyone who can't answer it.
cairns_silence.clue: The riddle carved into the seal reads: "I am given back to those who already have everything, and worth nothing to those who have lost it all. What am I?"

the_verge_wardens_toll.title: The Warden's Toll
the_verge_wardens_toll.description: Everything in the Hollow Verge has been standing at attention for the Warden's sake -- and it has finally noticed you're the reason the wait is over.
the_verge_wardens_toll.clue: The unfinished space at the sanctum's center hasn't decided what belongs in it yet -- right now, that's the Warden, and it knows it's temporary.

choir_remnants_echo.title: The Remnant's Echo
choir_remnants_echo.description: Whatever's left of this place's voice isn't willing to let anyone else borrow it.
choir_remnants_echo.clue: It doesn't attack so much as answer -- the same way an echo answers, whether or not you wanted it to.

still_machinery_wakes.title: What the Machinery Still Remembers
still_machinery_wakes.description: The Still Machinery hasn't moved in longer than memory -- but it hasn't forgotten how, either.
still_machinery_wakes.clue: Whatever it was built to carry, it's still trying to carry it -- straight through anyone standing in the way.

wordless_choirs_silence.title: The Choir's Silence
wordless_choirs_silence.description: The Choir Hall was built to carry one note to every corner at once -- but it's been asking the same question back for longer than anyone's been around to answer it.
wordless_choirs_silence.clue: The question carved into the hall's own walls reads: "Every voice down here says the same thing until it reaches me, and then it says nothing at all. What am I?"

the_undertones_reckoning.title: The Undertone's Reckoning
the_undertones_reckoning.description: Something has been humming, unheard, at the exact center of everything down here -- and it has finally noticed it isn't unheard anymore.
the_undertones_reckoning.clue: It was never trying to be found. That's exactly why it took this long.

hollow_watchers_vigil.title: The Hollow Watcher's Vigil
hollow_watchers_vigil.description: Whatever kept watch beneath the waiting shape's feet isn't ready to let anyone see what it was guarding.
hollow_watchers_vigil.clue: It doesn't seem surprised to see you. It seems disappointed it wasn't enough to stop you here.

turning_stairs_paradox.title: The Turning Stair's Paradox
turning_stairs_paradox.description: The stair won't let anyone reach the bottom while its guardian is still standing at every step of it at once.
turning_stairs_paradox.clue: It attacks from the step behind you exactly as often as the one ahead -- which shouldn't be possible on a stair with only one direction.

the_looms_pattern.title: The Loom's Pattern
the_looms_pattern.description: The Loom's threads all lead back to where they started -- and the room isn't letting anyone leave until they say so out loud.
the_looms_pattern.clue: The pattern woven into the threads reads: "I end where I began, and begin again where I ended. What am I?"

the_unbegun_reckoning.title: The Unbegun's Reckoning
the_unbegun_reckoning.description: Before the waiting shape, before the island, before the story anyone was ever told about this place -- something was already here, and it has finally run out of patience.
the_unbegun_reckoning.clue: It was never waiting to be found. It was waiting to see who'd actually come looking.

husk_orchards_reckoning.title: The Husk Orchard's Reckoning
husk_orchards_reckoning.description: Whatever still walks the orchard's dry rows remembers exactly what it was planted to do.
husk_orchards_reckoning.clue: It doesn't fight like a straggler. It fights like something that trained the rest of the field.

ashen_reliquarys_captive.title: The Ashen Reliquary's Captive
ashen_reliquarys_captive.description: Something has been kept here, chained to the collection, for longer than the collection has been worth keeping.
ashen_reliquarys_captive.clue: It doesn't try to flee when the chain finally gives. It just keeps tending the shelves.

the_forgotten_nooks_secret.title: The Forgotten Nook's Secret
the_forgotten_nooks_secret.description: Nobody was supposed to find this hollow -- which is exactly why something's still guarding it.
the_forgotten_nooks_secret.clue: It's smaller and quicker than its kin at the cairn -- like it grew up hiding rather than guarding.

antechambers_held_breath.title: The Antechamber's Held Breath
antechambers_held_breath.description: Whatever's meant to only pass through this space has decided to stay a while longer, specifically to stop you from doing the same.
antechambers_held_breath.clue: It's louder than the one at the gate. Whatever silence usually keeps it in check hasn't reached this far yet.

resonance_wells_answer.title: The Resonance Well's Answer
resonance_wells_answer.description: Something down the well has been answering back for longer than anyone's been listening -- and it's finally close enough to touch.
resonance_wells_answer.clue: It answers half a second late, every time -- like it's not quite in the same place the sound is.

the_forgotten_chords_return.title: The Forgotten Chord's Return
the_forgotten_chords_return.description: Something was scheduled here once and never got to happen -- or already did, so long ago that nobody's left who remembers it.
the_forgotten_chords_return.clue: It hums the start of something and stops, every time, right before the part that would let you recognize it.

the_afterimages_watch.title: The Afterimage's Watch
the_afterimages_watch.description: Whatever cast this impression is long gone -- but the shape it left behind hasn't stopped watching for it to come back.
the_afterimages_watch.clue: It moves like something remembering a motion, not making one.

the_last_measures_end.title: The Last Measure's End
the_last_measures_end.description: The Loom's very last thread was never going to resolve cleanly -- and whatever's tangled in it isn't interested in an exception.
the_last_measures_end.clue: It doesn't attack like it's trying to win. It attacks like it's trying to finish something.

the_missed_steps_fall.title: The Missed Step's Fall
the_missed_steps_fall.description: Whatever built this disconnected step built it on purpose -- and something's still down there making sure nobody climbs back out easily.
the_missed_steps_fall.clue: It's smaller than the guardian on the real stair -- like it was posted here to be forgotten, not to win.

supply_tunnels_veteran.title: The Supply Tunnel's Veteran
supply_tunnels_veteran.description: Whoever's better-guarded stash this is, the veteran watching it isn't giving up the tunnel without a real fight.
supply_tunnels_veteran.clue: It fights smarter than anything else in the warren -- like it's actually been trained, not just armed. A coin purse on its belt is too fine to be its own.

deep_larders_elder.title: The Deep Larder's Elder
deep_larders_elder.description: Someone's been stockpiling far more than this warren could ever need -- and the one guarding it clearly knows why.
deep_larders_elder.clue: It keeps glancing at the stockpile like it's protecting the supplies, not itself -- and for one long second before it moves, it looks right at you like it already knew you'd come. Whoever's really paying for all this clearly isn't the goblins.

the_collapsed_tunnels_survivor.title: The Collapsed Tunnel's Survivor
the_collapsed_tunnels_survivor.description: Something's been squatting in the rubble since long before the goblins ever moved in next door.
the_collapsed_tunnels_survivor.clue: It's scrawnier and quicker than anything in the main warren -- like it's been surviving alone here for a while.

flooded_gallerys_hold.title: The Flooded Gallery's Hold
flooded_gallerys_hold.description: Whatever's moving through the black water isn't going to let anyone wade past it unnoticed.
flooded_gallerys_hold.clue: It never actually surfaces -- it just keeps disturbing the water closer and closer to your feet.

the_channels_keeper.title: The Channel's Keeper
the_channels_keeper.description: The precise channel isn't as empty as it first looks -- something's been keeping it clear this whole time.
the_channels_keeper.clue: It moves like it's done this exact fight before, in this exact spot, more than once.

the_hollow_wellsprings_elder.title: The Hollow Wellspring's Elder
the_hollow_wellsprings_elder.description: Whatever's been drinking from this wellspring hasn't seen the surface in longer than anyone can guess -- and it's not interested in sharing.
the_hollow_wellsprings_elder.clue: Its magic tastes like the water itself -- old, still, and a lot deeper than it looks. It doesn't flinch when it sees you, either -- like it's been waiting this deep for exactly this long.

the_side_pools_straggler.title: The Side Pool's Straggler
the_side_pools_straggler.description: Something small has been squatting in the shallow offshoot, well out of the way of the main tunnels.
the_side_pools_straggler.clue: It's barely grown -- like it's been hiding here since long before it could've kept up with the rest of the tunnels.

web_hollows_brood.title: The Web Hollow's Brood
web_hollows_brood.description: Whatever's been spinning silk down here has had a long time to work, and it isn't done yet.
web_hollows_brood.clue: It doesn't chase -- it just keeps spinning, patient enough to let the silk do most of the work.

deep_currents_keeper.title: The Deep Current's Keeper
deep_currents_keeper.description: The current isn't empty the way it looks from the gorge above -- something's been keeping it that way on purpose.
deep_currents_keeper.clue: It moves with the water instead of against it -- like it's been doing this for as long as the current's existed.

the_undertows_elder.title: The Undertow's Elder
the_undertows_elder.description: Everything the deep current has ever dragged down eventually ends up here -- and whatever's waiting has had all of it to grow on.
the_undertows_elder.clue: Nothing that's gone into the current has ever climbed back out. This is apparently where it all went. It watches you cross the last stretch of water without once looking surprised.

silked_nooks_hatchling.title: The Silked Nook's Hatchling
silked_nooks_hatchling.description: Something small has been left to grow in the web hollow's quietest corner, well away from the rest of the brood.
silked_nooks_hatchling.clue: It's barely out of the egg -- and still more than willing to fight for the corner it was left in.

watchtowers_stalker.title: The Watchtower's Stalker
watchtowers_stalker.description: Something's been using the collapsed tower as a perch, and it isn't interested in sharing the view.
watchtowers_stalker.clue: It watches the bridge crossing the same way the tower's builders must have, once.

the_vantage_belows_alpha.title: Beneath the Vantage's Alpha
the_vantage_belows_alpha.description: The tower's collapsed base goes deeper than the ridge lets on -- and whatever's denning down there answers to something bigger.
the_vantage_belows_alpha.clue: The stalker up top was clearly reporting to this one, not the other way around.

the_tower_cellars_pup.title: The Tower Cellar's Pup
the_tower_cellars_pup.description: Something small has been using the half-buried storeroom to stay out of the wind.
the_tower_cellars_pup.clue: It's barely weaned -- and still willing to bare its teeth over a storeroom nobody else wants anymore.

the_barrow_depths_bound.title: The Barrow Depths' Bound
the_barrow_depths_bound.description: The sunken barrow's cold campsite was never anything but bait -- whatever's actually running this den is considerably further in.
the_barrow_depths_bound.clue: The supply cache up above was being restocked for this one, not for whoever was camping at the entrance. It's already facing the entrance when you arrive, like it heard you coming from somewhere further back than footsteps.

hollow_thresholds_bound_wolf.title: The Hollow Threshold's Bound Wolf
hollow_thresholds_bound_wolf.description: The passage narrows to almost nothing here -- and whatever's guarding it clearly isn't leaving without a fight.
hollow_thresholds_bound_wolf.clue: It's positioned exactly where the passage is narrowest -- like it was placed there on purpose, not just denning nearby.

the_stray_dens_wolf.title: The Stray Den's Wolf
the_stray_dens_wolf.description: Something's still using the half-collapsed den, even though it's clearly not the main pack's territory anymore.
the_stray_dens_wolf.clue: It's smaller and warier than the ones guarding the real threshold -- like it got pushed out here, not posted here.

the_deeper_roots_sentinel.title: The Deeper Roots' Sentinel
the_deeper_roots_sentinel.description: The unnaturally regular root-work finally makes sense: something was built here, and it's still doing its job.
the_deeper_roots_sentinel.clue: It doesn't move like anything alive. It moves like something that was told exactly how to move, a very long time ago.

the_deep_root_chambers_warden.title: The Deep Root Chamber's Warden
the_deep_root_chambers_warden.description: Whatever built this chamber wanted it kept exactly this way -- and the warden still guarding it hasn't gotten the memo that its makers are long gone.
the_deep_root_chambers_warden.clue: It's bigger, slower, and far more deliberate than the sentinel outside -- built for exactly this room, and nowhere else. It doesn't so much notice you as confirm you.

pools_wrought_spider.title: The Pool's Wrought Spider
pools_wrought_spider.description: The glimmering pool isn't as empty as the sunken coffer made it look -- something's been guarding whatever's really down there.
pools_wrought_spider.clue: It moves like it's spent its whole life in that light -- like the glow itself taught it how.

the_buried_glows_elder.title: The Buried Glow's Elder
the_buried_glows_elder.description: Whatever's buried in the silt isn't a crystal at all -- and it's not interested in being dug up.
the_buried_glows_elder.clue: It glows exactly like the crystals up above -- close enough that whoever named this place probably never noticed the difference. And for exactly as long as it takes to notice, it glows brighter when you walk in -- like it recognizes you, not just the light.

the_dim_hollows_spiderling.title: The Dim Hollow's Spiderling
the_dim_hollows_spiderling.description: Something small has made a home out of whatever light bleeds through into the dim hollow.
the_dim_hollows_spiderling.clue: It's barely grown into its own glow yet -- and still willing to defend the little of it that's made it this far.

the_unopened_seals_riddle.title: The Unopened Seal's Riddle
the_unopened_seals_riddle.description: The seal has never been opened -- only checked, over and over, by whoever kept coming back to make sure it still held.
the_unopened_seals_riddle.clue: The question worn into the seal reads: "Everyone who opens me finds exactly what they were afraid of, and exactly what they needed. What am I?"

the_unaskeds_reckoning.title: The Unasked's Reckoning
the_unaskeds_reckoning.description: Every quiet thing this world never explained -- the wait, the silence, the resonance, the threshold, the thing before the beginning -- was always the same question, asked over and over by everyone who ever came back to try again.
the_unaskeds_reckoning.clue: It was never waiting to be defeated. It was waiting to see who'd actually finish the question.

remnant_the_unopened.title: What the Seal Was Keeping In
remnant_the_unopened.description: Something real is still down here -- The Unopened never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_unopened.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_wrathflame_unbound.title: The Fire That Escaped First
remnant_the_wrathflame_unbound.description: Something real is still down here -- The Wrathflame Unbound never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_wrathflame_unbound.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_drowned_choir.title: The Song Under the Well
remnant_the_drowned_choir.description: Something real is still down here -- The Drowned Choir never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_drowned_choir.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_root_that_remembers.title: The Root Older Than the Forest
remnant_the_root_that_remembers.description: Something real is still down here -- The Root That Remembers never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_root_that_remembers.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_hollow_bell.title: The Bell That's Still Ringing
remnant_the_hollow_bell.description: Something real is still down here -- The Hollow Bell never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_hollow_bell.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_cairnbound.title: Whoever Piled These Stones
remnant_the_cairnbound.description: Something real is still down here -- The Cairnbound never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_cairnbound.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_waiting_dark.title: What Waited Under the Cairn
remnant_the_waiting_dark.description: Something real is still down here -- The Waiting Dark never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_waiting_dark.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_farthest_span.title: What Crosses the Bridge Uninvited
remnant_the_farthest_span.description: Something real is still down here -- The Farthest Span never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_farthest_span.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_buried_current.title: The Water That Forgot to Flow
remnant_the_buried_current.description: Something real is still down here -- The Buried Current never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_buried_current.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_spires_grace.title: The Spire That Still Faces Sunrise
remnant_the_spires_grace.description: Something real is still up here, above the clouds -- The Spire's Grace never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_spires_grace.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_archives_keeper.title: The Book With No Explaining Page
remnant_the_archives_keeper.description: Something real is still down here, older than the warren itself -- The Archive's Keeper never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_archives_keeper.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

remnant_the_deepest_record.title: The Last Page of the First City
remnant_the_deepest_record.description: Something real is still down here -- The Deepest Record never fully faded like the rest did.
remnant_the_deepest_record.clue: This one didn't scatter with the rest of what escaped -- it's still whole, somewhere quiet, waiting to be found.

wayfarers_circuit.title: The Wayfarer's Circuit
wayfarers_circuit.description: The Adventurers' Guild board wants a real circuit walked, not just paid work taken -- someone who's actually seen the ground the board's postings only describe secondhand.
wayfarers_circuit.clue: The board work only ever describes places secondhand -- the Guild wants someone who's actually walked as far as the den at the roots' end.

a_working_worth_watching.title: A Working Worth Watching
a_working_worth_watching.description: The Arcane Circle trades knowledge for loyalty, and there's a real working out past the Nook worth watching closely -- whatever's kept that bramble wall standing this long didn't grow there on its own.
a_working_worth_watching.clue: Something is holding that bramble wall together on purpose -- the Circle wants a real look at whatever it is.

a_wardens_vigil.title: A Warden's Vigil
a_wardens_vigil.description: The Silver Wardens noticed the world's darkening edges and organized against it -- a cairn watcher stirring is exactly the kind of edge they mean.
a_wardens_vigil.clue: The Wardens keep a real watch on anything undead stirring -- a cairn watcher's restlessness is worth answering before it settles into something worse.

the_quiet_climb.title: The Quiet Climb
the_quiet_climb.description: The Thieves' Guild asks too few questions and expects the same discretion in return -- get from the cellar to the upper rooms without anyone downstairs noticing you were ever in either.
the_quiet_climb.clue: The Ledger doesn't care how you get from the cellar to the rooms above -- only that nobody downstairs ever notices you made the climb.

a_blessing_for_the_downs.title: A Blessing for the Downs
a_blessing_for_the_downs.description: The Faith Circle mends what the world keeps breaking -- the grey, dim light over the Downs is exactly the kind of quiet wrongness they'd want carried a real blessing.
a_blessing_for_the_downs.clue: Carry the creek's own quiet out to the Downs -- the Circle says even a small blessing is worth more there than anywhere it's needed less.

the_deeper_seam.title: The Deeper Seam
the_deeper_seam.description: The Forge Guild trusts its own hammer and steel more than any spell -- prove it by following the root caverns' ore seam as far as it actually goes.
the_deeper_seam.clue: A smith who trusts steel over spells follows the seam all the way down, not just as far as the easy ore.

an_old_working_still_warm.title: An Old Working, Still Warm
an_old_working_still_warm.description: The Enchanters' Guild binds real magic into ring and blade rather than casting it themselves -- the walls of the Outer Ward stand at angles no living architect chose, and something in the gorge beneath the bridge is still, impossibly, warm with old work.
an_old_working_still_warm.clue: Whatever was enchanted into the gorge's depths is still working, generations later -- the Guild wants to know by whose hand, and how.

wrens_trial_by_fire.title: What Wren Won't Say
wrens_trial_by_fire.description: Wren keeps glancing toward the shrine's deeper stones every time a wolf howls too close -- she won't explain why until she's sure the wood's own threats are actually handled, not just quiet for the moment.
wrens_trial_by_fire.clue: Wren says she can't in good conscience show anyone what the shrine is really built over while something's still circling it.

the_glades_answer.title: The Glade's Answer
the_glades_answer.description: The ring of mushrooms in the Deep Glade is too even, too old, and too deliberate to be ignored any longer -- whatever it's asking, it wants a real answer before it lets anyone past.
the_glades_answer.clue: The ring of mushrooms in the glade doesn't look natural, and it doesn't look finished either -- like it's still waiting on something.

the_deep_forges_cinder_map.title: What the Forge Left Behind
the_deep_forges_cinder_map.description: The Deep Forge's last worker never came back for their things -- among them, a real chart of the vault below.
the_deep_forges_cinder_map.clue: The Molten Sentinel guards the way down to the old forge -- whatever it was protecting is worth a look once it's dealt with.

the_elder_roots_survey.title: What Grew Around It
the_elder_roots_survey.description: Something has been charting this vault for a very long time, root by root -- the elder root chamber is where that record is finally kept.
the_elder_roots_survey.clue: The Elder Bramble Husk has coiled itself around something for longer than it's been alive to notice.

the_wards_collapse.title: What the Ward Forgot
the_wards_collapse.description: The Outer Ward gives way to something even less finished further in -- whatever collapsed it did so all at once, on purpose.
the_wards_collapse.clue: The Forgotten Ward lies deeper north past the Outer Ward -- whatever's still wandering there hasn't noticed the city's already dead.

the_watchers_riddle.title: What the Glyph Is Asking
the_watchers_riddle.description: Something carved into Watcher's Walk has been asking the same question of everyone who passes, for longer than anyone's been alive to answer it.
the_watchers_riddle.clue: The Watching Glyph at the end of Watcher's Walk, past the Silent Market, poses a real riddle: "The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?"

the_spire_crowns_sentinel.title: What Still Guards the Crown
the_spire_crowns_sentinel.description: The Spire Crown, sealed off from the sky by more stone than should be possible, still has something standing watch inside it.
the_spire_crowns_sentinel.clue: The Spire Crown sits at the very top of the stair climbing up past the Spire Reaches.

the_forgotten_vaults_secret.title: Buried Twice
the_forgotten_vaults_secret.description: Something below even the Deepest Record was worth burying a second time -- worth finding out what, and why.
the_forgotten_vaults_secret.clue: Past the Deepest Record, the floor gives way to a real vault, deeper still.

the_unwritten_halls_answer.title: The One Bare Wall
the_unwritten_halls_answer.description: Every wall in this whole buried city is covered edge to edge in script -- except one, and that alone makes it worth real attention.
the_unwritten_halls_answer.clue: The Unwritten Hall's own silence carries a real question, if you know to ask it: "I am not written, yet every wall down here is covered in me. What am I?"

the_original_spires_reckoning.title: The Original Spire
the_original_spires_reckoning.description: Every glyph in this whole buried city has been leading down to the same place -- and the thing that's been repeating itself through all of it is finally, completely awake.
the_original_spires_reckoning.clue: The Final Count, deep past the Last Archive, is the last real guardian standing between the party and the Original Spire itself.

the_drifting_halls_threshold.title: What Drifts North
the_drifting_halls_threshold.description: The isle's stone keeps going north, well past where it should end into open sky.
the_drifting_halls_threshold.clue: North of the isle's center, the ground doesn't stop where it should.

the_folded_atriums_riddle.title: What the Folded Voice Asks
the_folded_atriums_riddle.description: Something in the Folded Atrium has been asking the same thing of everyone who reaches it, from every direction at once.
the_folded_atriums_riddle.clue: The Folded Voice poses a real question: "I finish before I start, and start again right where I finished. What am I?"

the_drifting_halls_warden.title: Where the Drifting Halls End
the_drifting_halls_warden.description: The halls to the north simply stop, all at once -- and something real is still standing guard where they do.
the_drifting_halls_warden.clue: The Folded Warden waits at the true end of the Drifting Halls, past the Folded Atrium.

the_mirrored_thresholds_echo.title: Which Way Is Down
the_mirrored_thresholds_echo.description: South of the isle's center, the stone reflects the sky so cleanly that up and down stop meaning much.
the_mirrored_thresholds_echo.clue: South of the isle's center, the ground itself starts acting like a mirror.

the_arguments_answer.title: Which One Spoke First
the_arguments_answer.description: Two voices argue endlessly in the Glass Garden's own reflection -- and neither will let the party pass until the argument's actually settled.
the_arguments_answer.clue: The Argument poses a real question: "Two voices agree on everything except which one of them spoke first. What are they?"

the_sunken_reflections_end.title: The Sunken Reflection
the_sunken_reflections_end.description: The reflection at the deepest, calmest point south of the isle finally shows something real -- and it's already looking back.
the_sunken_reflections_end.clue: Past the Argument of Echoes, where the reflection finally deepens, something real is waiting at the bottom of it.

the_radiant_stairs_climb.title: The First Real Warmth
the_radiant_stairs_climb.description: East of the isle's center, real warmth finally breaks through the cold -- the first sign that not everything up here is waiting to be fought.
the_radiant_stairs_climb.clue: East of the isle's center, a stair climbs toward real, warm light.

the_suns_thresholds_secret.title: What the Light Was Reaching For
the_suns_thresholds_secret.description: The radiant approach ends at a real threshold, warm enough now to be uncomfortable -- whatever's past it is the true source.
the_suns_thresholds_secret.clue: The High Approach Sentinel guards the last real stretch before the sun's own threshold.

deeper_rubbles_lurker.title: What the Rubble Was Hiding
deeper_rubbles_lurker.description: The cave-in west of the Collapsed Tunnel goes back much further than anyone squatting near the entrance ever bothered to dig.
deeper_rubbles_lurker.clue: West of the Collapsed Tunnel, the rubble keeps going long after it should have stopped.

the_old_seams_secret.title: A Seam No Goblin Cut
the_old_seams_secret.description: A real, deliberate seam in the rock -- cut by tools no goblin in this warren has ever owned.
the_old_seams_secret.clue: Past the deeper rubble, a seam in the rock was cut by something that wasn't a goblin.

the_idol_chambers_warden.title: What the Goblins Started Worshipping
the_idol_chambers_warden.description: The goblins have propped something up in a hollow deep past the old seam and started worshipping it, with no real idea what it actually is.
the_idol_chambers_warden.clue: The Idol Warden guards whatever the goblins have started treating like it matters, deep past the reverent hollow.

the_paymasters_route.title: A Route Worn Smooth
the_paymasters_route.description: North of the Deep Larder, a route worn smooth by real, regular foot traffic -- someone's been walking it on a real schedule.
