the_paymasters_route.clue: North past the Counting Hall, a route worn smooth by traffic no goblin walks that regularly.

the_ledger_vaults_answer.title: What the Bookkeeper Is Owed
the_ledger_vaults_answer.description: Something in the Ledger Vault has been keeping a perfect, obsessive count of everyone who passes -- and won't let anyone by until their own count is settled.
the_ledger_vaults_answer.clue: The Silent Bookkeeper poses a real question: "I never spend anything, yet everyone who passes through here owes me something. What am I?"

the_toll_masters_den.title: Whoever Runs the Finances
the_toll_masters_den.description: Whoever actually runs this warren's finances keeps their own den well guarded, well away from the goblins they're using.
the_toll_masters_den.clue: The Toll Master's Den lies north past the Ledger Vault.

the_true_paymasters_reckoning.title: The True Paymaster
the_true_paymasters_reckoning.description: The real seat of whatever's been running this warren all along -- and it's been expecting company for a while now.
the_true_paymasters_reckoning.clue: Past the Final Ledger, the Paymaster's Approach leads straight to whoever's really been in charge.

the_cleared_chokes_stalker.title: What Kept Clearing the Choke
the_cleared_chokes_stalker.description: The rubble that used to choke the deep tunnels almost shut has clearly been cleared, on purpose, more than once.
the_cleared_chokes_stalker.clue: West of the Deep Tunnels, the old rubble choke has clearly been cleared on purpose.

the_smugglers_cuts_lurker.title: Not a Goblin Tunnel
the_smugglers_cuts_lurker.description: A real, deliberate cut through the rock, wide enough for real cargo -- nothing a goblin ever dug.
the_smugglers_cuts_lurker.clue: Past the cleared choke, a real cut through the rock leads further west.

the_smugglers_ends_warden.title: Where the Route Ends
the_smugglers_ends_warden.description: The smuggling route through the caverns finally ends here, well guarded, well away from anything a goblin would defend.
the_smugglers_ends_warden.clue: The Smuggler's Warden guards the true end of the route, past the Last Crossing.

the_deep_currents_shard.title: The Water Runs Colder
the_deep_currents_shard.description: North past the Hollow Wellspring, the water runs colder and faster than anything upstream should allow.
the_deep_currents_shard.clue: North of the Hollow Wellspring, a real spring stair leads deeper still.

the_kept_shrines_vigil.title: The Kept Shrine
the_kept_shrines_vigil.description: A real shrine, kept clean and lit by something that isn't a torch -- and someone's clearly still using it.
the_kept_shrines_vigil.clue: Deep past the Deep Current, a shrine has been kept far too clean to be abandoned.

the_sources_reckoning.title: The Source
the_sources_reckoning.description: Every current in these caverns starts here -- and whatever's actually keeping it moving has been waiting a very long time to be found.
the_sources_reckoning.clue: The Deepest Approach, past the Last Root, leads straight to the true source of every current in these caverns.

the_lower_battlements_watchman.title: Someone Still Watches the Crossing
the_lower_battlements_watchman.description: Real fortification, cut into the gorge wall above the bridge -- whoever built this crossing meant to defend it, and something's still standing watch.
the_lower_battlements_watchman.clue: Real fortification climbs the gorge wall above the bridge itself.

the_carved_gates_riddle.title: Older Than the Gate Around It
the_carved_gates_riddle.description: A real gate, carved with the same worn script as the bridge's own rail -- and it won't let anyone through without a real answer.
the_carved_gates_riddle.clue: The Gate Carving poses a real question: "I have stood here longer than the bridge, and I will still be standing after it falls. What am I?"

the_old_keeps_warden.title: The Old Keep
the_old_keeps_warden.description: The real keep at the top of the fortification -- and whatever's actually still keeping it has been waiting a long time to be found.
the_old_keeps_warden.clue: The Keeper's Hall, past the Tower's Crown, is the last real room before the keep proper.

the_watchers_perchs_answer.title: What the Perch Has Seen
the_watchers_perchs_answer.description: A real perch, high enough in the gorge wall to see every approach at once -- and it's been keeping a real count of everyone who's crossed unseen.
the_watchers_perchs_answer.clue: The Watcher's Perch poses a real question: "I see everyone who crosses, and I am never the one who's seen. What am I?"

the_lower_spans_widow.title: What Claimed the Lower Span
the_lower_spans_widow.description: A real, lower span of the gorge, well below the bridge itself -- something old has clearly claimed it.
the_lower_spans_widow.clue: The Lower Span lies east past the Watcher's Perch.

the_scouting_grounds_warning.title: Fresh Tracks
the_scouting_grounds_warning.description: Footprints in the dust, still fresh, lead further east onto real, level ground -- someone's been watching this whole crossing from a real distance, and recently.
the_scouting_grounds_warning.clue: The tracks lead east from the Scout's Camp, onto open ground.

the_sunken_cellars_warden.title: What the Cellar Kept
the_sunken_cellars_warden.description: A real hall below the tower cellar, kept exactly as it was left -- and something's still keeping it that way.
the_sunken_cellars_warden.clue: The Cellar Warden's Hall lies deep below the Tower Cellar, past the Watcher's Grave.

the_downs_own_marker_riddle.title: The Line That Never Moves
the_downs_own_marker_riddle.description: A real boundary marker, older than the watchtower, still keeping the same line it always has.
the_downs_own_marker_riddle.clue: The Downs' Own Marker poses a real question: "I mark the same line every year, and I am never the one who moves. What am I?"

the_downs_last_watchs_reckoning.title: The Downs' Last Watch
the_downs_last_watchs_reckoning.description: The real, final watch beneath the Downs -- and whatever's kept it this whole time has been waiting a very long time to be relieved.
the_downs_last_watchs_reckoning.clue: The Final Approach, past the Last Cellar, leads straight to whatever's actually still keeping this watch.

the_ash_wardens_riddle.title: What the Warden Guards
the_ash_wardens_riddle.description: The Ash-Bound Warden won't move from the gallery wall until its question is actually answered -- not guessed at, answered.
the_ash_wardens_riddle.clue: The Ash-Bound Warden poses a real question: "I am not alive, yet I grow. I have no lungs, yet I need air. I have no mouth, yet water kills me. What am I?"

the_cinder_keys_reckoning.title: The Cinder Key
the_cinder_keys_reckoning.description: Something molten still guards whatever the vault's old wardens locked away -- and it isn't going to just hand it over.
the_cinder_keys_reckoning.clue: The alcove's own bound guardian won't move until it's put down for good.

the_root_bound_alcoves_secret.title: What the Voice Protects
the_root_bound_alcoves_secret.description: The Bramble-Bound Voice won't let anyone past the wall until its own question is actually answered.
the_root_bound_alcoves_secret.clue: The Bramble-Bound Voice poses a real question: "I fall so I can rise again. I sleep for years, then wake in a single day. What am I?"

the_last_seeds_reckoning.title: The Last Seed
the_last_seeds_reckoning.description: Something withered has been curled around this seed for longer than anything down here should still be moving -- and it isn't letting go without a fight.
the_last_seeds_reckoning.clue: Whatever's curled around the seed won't move until it's put down for good, and it isn't the same thing you've fought anywhere else.

the_silt_hollows_reckoning.title: The Silt-Sealed Key
the_silt_hollows_reckoning.description: Something's been curled around a real, deliberately shaped key for longer than anything down here should still be moving.
the_silt_hollows_reckoning.clue: Whatever's curled around the key in the Silt Hollow won't move until it's put down for good.

the_choked_reliquarys_answer.title: What the Water Remembers
the_choked_reliquarys_answer.description: The voice behind the reliquary wall won't move until its own real question is actually answered.
the_choked_reliquarys_answer.clue: The Choked Reliquary's Voice poses a real question: "I have no mouth, yet every name spoken over my still surface sends ripples outward long after the sound fades. I have no hands, yet nothing that sinks beneath me is ever given back. What am I?"

the_deep_veins_reckoning.title: The Vein Key
the_deep_veins_reckoning.description: Whatever's been picking through this vein for scraps has a real, deliberately cut key among its hoard -- and it isn't giving it up quietly.
the_deep_veins_reckoning.clue: Whatever's guarding the vein won't move until it's put down for good.

the_wardens_hollows_reckoning.title: The Warden's Key
the_wardens_hollows_reckoning.description: Whatever's been guarding this hollow has a real key among what it's hoarded -- and it isn't giving it up quietly.
the_wardens_hollows_reckoning.clue: Whatever's guarding the hollow won't move until it's put down for good.

the_drifting_hollows_reckoning.title: The Drifting Key
the_drifting_hollows_reckoning.description: Something's been circling a real, deliberately shaped key for longer than anything this far from solid ground should still be moving.
the_drifting_hollows_reckoning.clue: Whatever's circling the hollow won't move until it's put down for good.

the_old_watchs_reckoning.title: The Old Watch Key
the_old_watchs_reckoning.description: Whatever's been keeping this post has a real, deliberately cut key among what it's hoarded -- and it isn't giving it up quietly.
the_old_watchs_reckoning.clue: Whatever's guarding the old watch post won't move until it's put down for good.

the_old_archives_reckoning.title: The Old Archive Key
the_old_archives_reckoning.description: Whatever's been guarding this sealed record-room has a real, deliberately cut key among what it's hoarded -- and it isn't giving it up quietly.
the_old_archives_reckoning.clue: Whatever's guarding the old archive won't move until it's put down for good.

arc_1_discovery.title: Discovery
arc_1_discovery.description: Small, strange things, easy to explain away individually.

arc_2_descent.title: The Descent
arc_2_descent.description: The pattern beneath the strangeness starts to surface.

arc_3_revelation.title: What Was Buried
arc_3_revelation.description: The truth of what the surface world was built on top of.

arc_4_ascension.title: What Waits Above
arc_4_ascension.description: The final confrontation, far from where anyone thought to look.

arc_5_goblin_warrens.title: What the Warren Was Hiding
arc_5_goblin_warrens.description: The goblins were never the whole story -- just the part that was easiest to notice first.

arc_6_sunken_root_caverns.title: What the Roots Kept
arc_6_sunken_root_caverns.description: Water finds every gap a root leaves behind, and something's been using every one of them.

arc_7_stonearch_gorge.title: What the Gorge Swallowed
arc_7_stonearch_gorge.description: Everything that's ever gone into the current eventually ends up somewhere. This is where.

arc_8_greymoor_downs.title: What the Downs Still Watches
arc_8_greymoor_downs.description: A watchtower and a burial mound, both still doing the job they were built for, long after anyone thought to check.

arc_9_whispering_wood.title: What Was Built, Not Grown
arc_9_whispering_wood.description: Somewhere under the Wood, the roots stopped being roots a long time before anyone noticed.

arc_10_glimmerdeep_grotto.title: What the Glow Isn't
arc_10_glimmerdeep_grotto.description: Not everything down here that shines is a crystal.

arc_11_hollow_verge.title: The Hollow Verge
arc_11_hollow_verge.description: The first rebirth doesn't just raise a ceiling -- it opens a door nobody could reach before.

arc_12_wordless_choir.title: The Wordless Choir
arc_12_wordless_choir.description: Past The Unrepeating, something built entirely around silence is still, somehow, being heard.

arc_13_the_unbegun.title: The Unbegun
arc_13_the_unbegun.description: Before the waiting shape, before the island, before the story anyone was ever told -- something was already here.

arc_14_the_answered.title: The Answered
arc_14_the_answered.description: Every quiet thing this world ever tried not to explain was always the same question, sealed the same way, waiting for someone who'd already been asked it enough times to finally answer back.

crossroads_folk.name: The Crossroads Folk
crossroads_folk.description: The ordinary people who keep the Crossroads running — innkeepers, traders, and the wanderers who pass through and stay a while. No oaths, no hierarchy, just people who look out for each other.

blackthorn_raiders.name: The Blackthorn Raiders
blackthorn_raiders.description: A loose band of highwaymen and opportunists preying on the roads between settlements. Small, cruel, and — some in the Crossroads whisper — funded by something bigger than banditry.

the_wanderers_road.name: The Wanderers' Road
the_wanderers_road.description: An informal fellowship of drifters, hermits, and those who owe allegiance to no settlement or crown. Neither friend nor enemy by default — standing with them is earned entirely by what you actually do.

marens_riddle.riddle: I have cities, but no houses; forests, but no trees; rivers, but no water. What am I?

elder_glen_riddle.riddle: I have many rings but no fingers, many arms but no hands, and I tell your age without ever asking. What am I?

archive_recess_riddle.riddle: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?

hollow_verge_riddle.riddle: I am given back to those who already have everything, and worth nothing to those who have lost it all. What am I?

wordless_choir_riddle.riddle: Every voice down here says the same thing until it reaches me, and then it says nothing at all. What am I?

unmoored_isle_loom_riddle.riddle: I end where I began, and begin again where I ended. What am I?

unopened_seal_riddle.riddle: Everyone who opens me finds exactly what they were afraid of, and exactly what they needed. What am I?

deep_glade_ring_riddle.riddle: I grow in a circle and never step outside it. Everything that has ever touched me, I still carry. What am I?

watchers_walk_riddle.riddle: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?

unwritten_hall_riddle.riddle: I am not written, yet every wall down here is covered in me. What am I?

folded_atrium_riddle.riddle: I finish before I start, and start again right where I finished. What am I?

argument_of_echoes_riddle.riddle: Two voices agree on everything except which one of them spoke first. What are they?
accepted_answers: a reflection and what it reflects

ledger_vaults_riddle.riddle: I never spend anything, yet everyone who passes through here owes me something. What am I?

tangled_hollow_riddle.riddle: I hold everything together and let nothing through. What am I?

wellsprings_answer_riddle.riddle: I am never the same twice, yet I always find the lowest point. What am I?

carved_gates_riddle.riddle: I have stood here longer than the bridge, and I will still be standing after it falls. What am I?

watchers_perch_riddle.riddle: I see everyone who crosses, and I am never the one who's seen. What am I?

downs_own_marker_riddle.riddle: I mark the same line every year, and I am never the one who moves. What am I?

ash_wardens_riddle.riddle: I am not alive, yet I grow. I have no lungs, yet I need air. I have no mouth, yet water kills me. What am I?

root_bound_alcoves_riddle.riddle: I fall so I can rise again. I sleep for years, then wake in a single day. What am I?

choked_reliquarys_riddle.riddle: I have no mouth, yet every name spoken over my still surface sends ripples outward long after the sound fades. I have no hands, yet nothing that sinks beneath me is ever given back. What am I?
